The numerous examples are based on real consulting situations from engineers of all professional sectors to the management or board level. Graphics and sample texts for applications as well as the possibility to be directly provided by the author via e-mail make the book a valuable treasure trove. Hans Bürkle has made a career as a board member in the industry, thus his tips have a concrete, authentic practical relevance. As career consultant, he has already led a variety of engineers and other executives to professional success.
content.title_en: Career strategy and application training for the experienced engineer

content.text: Handbook Mobile-Commerce : Technical basics, market opportunities and application possibilities. By supporting mobile users, the virtualization of the markets is given a further boost. The numerous examples of application will help the practically active structural planner to clarify the implementation of the formal evidence. Therefore, the basics of the safety concept and the concrete technology are explained in this book. The proofs in the limit state of the load capacity for bending without longitudinal force, for transverse force, torsion and punching as well as for rod-shaped components with longitudinal pressure form the foundations of the design in the steel concrete construction. Furthermore, the design of prestressed structures, the proof of suitability for use, for fatigue, rod structure models and structural perforation are treated and illustrated by detailed examples.
content.title_en: Reinforced concrete and prestressed concrete structures according to DIN 1045 : Parts 1 to 3 (July 2001) Explanations and applications

content.text: Electrical machines and drives : Basics, motors and applications. Basic knowledge about the operating behaviour of DC, AC and DC machines and transformers is indispensable for the engineer in the field of drive engineering development. Furthermore, knowledge about electromagnetic-mechanical energy conversion is helpful. This textbook provides the basics for this. Numerous detailed calculation examples facilitate the understanding of the material. The presentation of the theoretical basics has been simplified to such an extent that basic knowledge of electrical engineering is sufficient to understand. The second edition contains, among other things, updated standards in particular on explosion protection, standard formulae marks, new examples on the section synchronous machines, DC motors and induction law as well as additions to the chapter asynchronous machines
content.title_en: Electrical machinery and drives : Basics, motors and applications

content.text: Service networks : Management, success factors and benchmarks in an international comparison. Although the importance of the service sector is also increasing with us, it has not gained importance as in other countries and the sector is not one of the "export world champions". This book shows that service providers, which are organized as a network, can improve their competitive position by combining customer proximity with efficient system background. After a conceptual overview empirical results of an international benchmarking study on the success factors of service networks are presented. Five success factors are identified and their implementation is processed in the form of "Best Practice Case Studies". These case studies present the most successful benchmarks internationally. The presentation of franchising and cooperation networks and reflections on the "ideal service work" form the conclusion of the book
content.title_en: Service networks : Management, success factors and benchmarks in an international comparison

content.text: Why do tea and coffee pots drop? How can you roast a steak? Why don't commercial aircraft fly faster? Should you turn off the heating in the house in the short time you are away? These are questions about four of 50 thermofluid dynamic everyday phenomena that are treated uniformly and systematically according to the following scheme: Description of the phenomenon / principal explanation / Further considerations. In addition, a detailed glossary helps in the physical understanding of the technical terms. The content of this article is related to the following categories: - House and garden - Food and beverages - Travel and leisure - Energy and environment The target groups - Natural scientists, engineers, interested lay people - Lecturers of thermofluid dynamics or of sub-areas of it The author Dr.-Ing. Heinz Herwig is a professor at the TU Hamburg-Harburg and heads the Institute of Thermofluid Dynamics.
content.title_en: Oh, that's how it is! : 50 thermofluid dynamic everyday phenomena vividly and scientifically explained

content.text: Energy efficiency in Germany - a meta-study : Analysis and recommendations. The Stuttgart Institute for Energy Efficiency in Production has developed the first meta-study "Energy efficiency in Germany" which provides figures, data and facts on the state of development and knowledge of energy efficiency in Germany. The study shows which contribution individual measures have made so far and which potentials are known but have not yet been raised. For this meta-study, more than 250 publications by research institutions, ministries, trade and industry associations with a focus on energy efficiency were identified and evaluated. It provides an overview of the state of development and is an important reference work for industry, associations and politics. Introduction -- Energy efficiency by sector -- Industry -- Buildings -- Transport -- Trends and forecasts -- Summary, outlook and final evaluation.
content.title_en: Energy efficiency in Germany - a meta-study : Analysis and recommendations

content.text: Science in Focus V : Basics of Biology in the Context of Evolution and Religion. This volume provides an insight into the current developments in biology. As part of the life sciences, biology has gained a special position in recent years, which it places increasingly in the context of evolution and religions. The processes in the animated nature are difficult to understand and more complex than anything that exists in the inanimate nature. Questions of a fundamental nature arise: Are the life processes merely special forms of physical-chemical processes, energetically fed by the sun, or do they require an additional, special "vibrational power", a vital dissolution with life? content.text: Mining and environment. Mining, which has been partially centuries old in Germany, is now predominantly stopped, but mining facilities closed for decades continue to affect the environment. In connection with the question of geogenic background values and anthropogenic over-emphasis, the topic of mining and environment has a special role to play in addition to the special problem of old-state loads. The collection of articles presented in this volume of the GUG series deals with long-term geochemical influences from mining plants, in particular aspects of pyrite weathering, hydrogeochemical reactions and the use of industrial residues. The book presents current research on these aspects and mainly addresses environmental geoscientists (geologists, geochemists, mineralogens) who are experts. However, environmental managers as well as landscape and spatial planners will also find important statements in this book.
content.title_en: Mining and environment

content.text: The physics of our environment: The atmosphere. This book is derived from a two-semester lecture on the physics of the atmosphere in the framework of the subject Environmental Physics and the University of Heidelberg. It is conceived as an introductory textbook and pursues two interlinked objectives: - It aims to make the functioning of the system atmosphere understandable. This purpose serves sections on the radiation and energy balance, on atmospheric dynamics, on circulations, on precipitation formation, on the water cycle and on similar topics. - It wants to work out, in a broad sense, environmental aspects of meteorology and atmospheric physics. To this end, a detailed presentation of diffusion and transport processes, numerous sections on the behaviour of trace substances, with emphasis on radiation-relevant trace gases and on suspended particles, and finally a discussion of climate developments and their evaluation. The present third edition is again completely revised, several parts are completely new written. Thus, e.g. the dynamics of the stratosphere has received a much greater weight, it has again proved necessary to grasp the chapter on trace gases and to include more extensive information on the physics of our students and the subject.
content.title_en: Physics of our environment: the atmosphere

content.text: European fossil deposits. This book on European fossil deposits is aimed at a wide readership. content.text: Climate evidence of Earth's history. Are we living in a climatic emergency state - from an earth-historical point of view? The extinction of dinosaurs about 65 million years ago marks only one of many events in the billions of years old Earth's history. The investigation of such events, the role of the oceans or geological evidence of climate processes are important aids in the reconstruction of climate events in the past of the Earth. The Earth has a variety of evidences about climate conditions in its historical past. Geoscientists can decipher these testimonies and make them usable for the future. A decisive step for the acceptance of the ecosystem "earth" lies in the inclusion of the modeling of complex systems and in the knowledge of the possibilities and limits of the assessment of models in general. A current literature directory and a detailed glossary can be found at the end of the book.

content.text: Lean and Industry 4.0: a digitalisation strategy based on the flow of value. Digitalisation in production – where it is worth it. On this basis, smart products and smart services can be developed in the next step. content.text: All just bought? : Corruption in the Federal Republic since 1949. Corruption runs through the entire history of the Federal Republic. Even the decision for Bonn as capital in 1949 was bought. In reality, it would be impossible to imagine a democratic community without the combination of politics on the one hand and economy and money on the other. A banana republic, as often said in the wake of the Flick affair, has therefore never been Germany. Jens Ivo Engels, who was the first German historian to study the subject scientifically, analyses the most important corruption cases, embeds them in its social environment as in the international discussion on transparency and good governance and shows: the discussion of corruption in the public is an outstanding indicator of the respective political constitution of a state.

content.text: In the shadow of Humboldt: a tragic story of German ethnology. From the high ideals of Alexander von Humboldt to the bitter dispute over the Humboldt Forum, a long and winding path leads through German history. Hardly anything illustrates him better than the ethnological collection of the Berlin Museum - with 500,000 objects one of the largest in the world. H. Glenn Penny describes in his illuminating book how this gigantic collection was created, what was behind it for motives and why its original idea is hardly considered today. His book is an indispensable contribution to the objectification of the debate about the colonial heritage of German museums.
content.title_en: In the shadow of Humboldt: a tragic story of German ethnology

In addition, climate policy increasingly often hours of truth stand in front of the: traffic turnaround, energy turnaround, agricultural turnaround - the interventions that are necessary to severely limit global warming are deep, the upcoming changes will have real losers and winners, they will have opportunities and pains. No wonder that the dispute is now moving into the political center and all other issues re-examined - from social justice to democracy and human rights. The political culture of the country is not prepared for this. Still, there is no search for a policy for the problems, but vice versa: the problems are so corrected that they fit the policies we know. This repression of ecological confidence can overcome this new situation, and the new freedom of speech is won by Ulrich.

content.text: Energy in plastics technology: Basics and applications for engineers. The book provides the necessary basics for the processing of thermal engineering questions in plastics like no other book. The subject areas are: thermodynamics (main principles, treatment of chemical transformations); fluid mechanics including the rationale of the theory of similarity; heat transfer (free and forced convection, stationary and instationary heat conduction, some aspects of heat transfer through radiation); thermal and caloric state behaviour, deformation and flow behaviour of plastics (rheology). The basics provided are applied - in the sense of exemplar calculations - to practical problems in the most important processing and processing processes: heating and cooling processes of tools, extrusion, blow forming, spray casting, pressing of Duro and Thermoplasts, calendering, etc. The focus is on the energy-economic and temperature-reducing of the plastics industry (the plastics industry and the plastics industry).

content.text: Our Asian future. From an Asian perspective, the People's Republic of China often appears as an exemplary counter-project to a supposedly declining, morally exhausted and inflexible "West". The latter is also the tenor of the book by the Indian-born political scientist of the National University in Singapore. In the fact-rich and often provocative presentation, Khanna tends to attribute advantages in global competition to a vast but somewhat inaccurately described as "Asia". This concerns state-led capitalism and essentially technocratic, purely efficiency-oriented forms of government. The presented theses are not really new, yet this Asian perspective is recommended in addition to the discourse that prevails in us, for here China, or even "Asia", is considered to be a more or less threatening challenge for Europe.(2)
content.title_en: Our Asian Future

content.text: A thousand lines of lies: the Relotius system and German journalism. It was the biggest forgery scandal in decades: a reporter of the "Spiegel" had delivered reports and interviews from home and abroad, moving and often with the painting of the special. content.text: Functional safety in the automobile: the challenge for electric mobility and automated driving. Functional safety in the automobile. The reason for this are the precursors of a rapidly changing automotive market. Electric mobility is in the coming, the days of the combustion engine seem to be counted. Even the role of the driver is redefined or even challenged. The completely revised book deals with many questions about the safety that these changes bring with it: - Which laws are relevant in which market and for which mobility concepts? - What changes are accepted by society? - What methods and best practices are there? - What is the state of science and technology? - What is relevant and how can it be adapted for future concepts? - What experiences are there in other industries? Are we at the end all passengers in rolling or flying passenger transport systems only? All these questions go far beyond the safety concept of ISO 26262. In this book time, car operators want to offer safe aspects for the car operator.

content.text: Interculturality and Waldorf education. In Germany, there are now about 19 million people with a migrant background. Especially the schools face the challenge of educating the social, linguistic, cultural and religious heterogeneity that has emerged – so far without any major success. Waldorf education is also required in this context, and the present volume shows the existing approaches and potentials. Thus, initiatives have already been developed that combine the personal orientation of Waldorf education, which aims at individual promotion, with the universal approach of salutogenesis and the pursuit of cultural diversity. These aspects also form the background for the internationality of the Waldorf School and Waldorf Kindergarten movement, which is now present on all continents.
content.title_en: Interculturality and Waldorf Education

content.text: The relevance of the study is not limited to the domestic work of development policy, but also to other areas in which learning processes and impact observation play a role, such as development cooperation, environmental education or political education. – Susanne von Jan, in: Zeitschrift für Evaluation 1/2020, p. 175f. The demand for a stronger impact orientation has also for some years been covered by development policy domestic work. The implementation of this demand is not trivial, because here education and awareness processes are the main focus, which depend on many influences and thus elude classical causal evaluation designs. Therefore, for a long time now, it has been discussed what can be understood in development policy domestic work under effect, and how these effects can be determined. Both questions are discussed within the framework of the research project "Effectives and methods of impact observation in development policy domestic work" which can be considered in the context of the project on the topic of impact and development.
content.title_en: Impact orientation in domestic development work

content.text: Real-time systems: Basics of planning. Real-time systems are used to get processes to the right action at the right time. They are used, for example, for controlling production systems, automated car driving or even for voice transmission in worldwide networks. Literature on this topic has not yet been discussed here, although the book is already available in the second edition. The author is known through research on real-time systems and through the development of concepts and methods in this field. The book begins with the characteristics of a real-time model and then comes very quickly to the basic model of a real-time system. The focus is on methodological and technical foundations of real-time systems and basic planning procedures. Advanced planning methods (synchronized processes, multiprocessor systems, ...) are only briefly discussed. Many tasks (with solutions) and practical examples (including recording a truck toll on motorways).
content.title_en: Real-time systems : basics of planning

content.text: Introduction to Data Science : Basic principles of data analysis with Python. The book is a new edition of Grus, which now relies on the current version 3.6 of Python and introduces into the foundations of data science as an interdisciplinary field of science for the acquisition of new insights from very different data. The new edition should replace the old version with good use, as a downward compatibility of the new version of Python to earlier versions is only conditionally given. The author requires some basic knowledge from the reader. Thus, Python basic knowledge is only refreshed once more in a crash course. The actual entry begins with a scenario in DataSciencester, a fictional social network for data scientists. Also, new important facts about deep learning, statistics and language processing are taught compared to the first edition. Beginners who only search for a general overview should also be pointed out to A. Ng, who also deals with data science, but only shows using very simple and plausible examples and applications, what can be achieved in this way.
content.title_en: Introduction to Data Science : Basic principles of data analysis with Python

content.text: The dynamic company: how change of values, innovation and digitalization lead to success. Looking for a successful way for the digital transformation of your company and building on the strengths of your business? Then this book offers you a variety of future-oriented and practical solutions that you can apply immediately. The dynamic company combines an esteemed corporate culture and a high level of innovation with agile organizational structures - it makes change holistic and allows you to do so step by step. What you need to know is explained to you on the basis of current scientific studies and impressive case studies. The practical tools to this end make the immediate application in your company easy. Whether design thinking, future work concepts or new forms of collaboration: The authors have the strategies of the dynamic company with leading minds in Silicon Valley, experts at the German research tip, active start-up founders and leaders of innovation laboratories in German-speaking companies will benefit from this innovative solution variety.
content.title_en: The dynamic company: how change of values, innovation and digitalization lead to success

content.text: Manual Competence Measurement : recognize, understand and evaluate competences in company, educational and psychological practice. Competences are the key to future personnel management. How can they be recognized, recorded and measured? The manual covers a wide range of procedures for competence measurement and characterisation. The approach of competence measurement towards a general competence acquisition is extended. In the new edition, the manual was supplemented by practical measuring methods that represent self-organized action and the range of competences, including: Living Competence Models, BALI-F, KOMBI Runway Consulting and Talentkompass NRW. With an overview of all the competence measurement and acquisition processes used in Europe.
content.title_en: Manual of Competence Measurement : recognize, understand and evaluate skills in company, educational and psychological practice

content.text: Digitality and privacy: cultural, political-legal and social perspectives. Data protection remains a competitive topic in the context of the advancing digitalisation. The contributions of the volume explore the question of which forms privateness can take in a digital society and what opportunities and risks arise. Media-cultural questions arise about the normation patterns behind digital applications as well as the need to analyse, classify and evaluate digital usage scenarios.The interdisciplinary volume gathers cultural, social, media, legal and political perspectives.
content.title_en: Digitality and privacy : cultural, political, legal and social perspectives

content.text: This textbook provides a compressed overview of the law of corporate taxation and provides the basic structures of the most important tax types for companies. The book is addressed to students of law and economics and business law at universities, universities of applied sciences, administrative and business academies as well as to practitioners interested in tax law. Numerous illustrations and graphs as well as examples and exercises with solutions make the teaching material vivid and facilitate understanding of this demanding area of law. This makes the work particularly suitable for reading during lectures and for preparing for exams.
content.title_en: Basic principles of corporate taxation

Formula and reality -- The aesthetics of formula: formulas are images -- The mathematical actors: 1 + 1 = 2, from which everything follows -- Here comes movement into formula: A small algebra -- Examples Folding text: difficulties with reading formulas? You know people who can read so much from a formula without effort? What is their secret? Quite simply: You know how to read a formula correctly. The formula reading book familiarizes you systematically with all the important aspects of reading formulas: questions of language, of the respective factual context and perception are answered just as much as your understanding of structural questions and formula specifics is extended. The formula is actually the focus of this book and the principle of how to "define" it properly - and continue to work with it: so that one learns what a formula has to say interestingly. And all this without higher mathematics but with concrete examples from physics, biology, geography, mathematics ... content.text: Key figures for the construction and real estate industry - including work aids online. Raster measure, All Risk Yield, real estate interest rate: In the real estate industry, there are many technical terms that do not always immediately reveal their significance. Students, participants in education and training as well as practitioners must know what is behind them in this world of concepts and what lies behind them. This book gives you a sound overview of the key figures. It shows which calculation rules are behind them, which are the main factors influencing them and what you can conclude from the figure. In addition, you get the most important definitions from the real estate industry. New in the second edition: an additional chapter on the topic of real estate bubbles with their specific indicators. Contents: location and property analysis; valuation of real estate; financing forms and loan types; taxes and depreciation for real estate; calculation of management and maintenance costs correctly.
content.title_en: Key figures for the construction and real estate industry - including work aids online

content.text: Human collaboration management : Human resources managers as consultants and designers in a networked working environment. Networking and collaboration - these principles are increasingly at the forefront of today's corporate world. The book shows how personnel managers can take a new role in the context of this development: namely as drivers and companions of the change towards more collaboration. Based on concrete ideas, suggestions and examples, the author explains how the change towards human collaboration management can succeed, for example in terms of: culture and leadership style; processes such as assessment and remuneration systems; operational structures.
content.title_en: Human collaboration management : Human resources managers as consultants and designers in a networked working environment

content.text: Special business administration of the real estate industry. For practitioners as well as for the training, further and further training for real estate merchants: The "Murfeld" has long been indispensable for practitioners as well as for training and further training. The author team from renowned real estate experts does not leave any unanswered business-related question. The textbook deals with all planned innovations in rental law in its 8th edition. The updated edition contains new BGH-principles, the amended construction contract law as well as the training obligation for real estate managers and brokers. Contents: The entire real estate industry in 15 chapters, among others: companies and markets of real estate industry. Controlling and marketing. Taxes and insurance for real estate. Construction technical foundations. Real estate development, property financing and property management. Acquisition and sale, the broker as a service provider. In the new edition: All innovations to the rental law. Current BGH-principles. Changed construction contract law since 1.1.2018. The training obligation for real estate managers and brokers.
content.title_en: Special business administration of the real estate industry

content.text: Data protection in the housing industry - including work aids online. The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) replaces the previous EU data protection directive. In this respect, the Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) has also been amended. This book represents the impact of the regulation on housing companies. It shows how the data of members or tenants should be treated in compliance with the law in the future. Attention: In case of violation, fines are threatened! Contents: Basic and principles of data protection; Overview of the changes by GDPR; Documentation obligations; Information obligations; Data protection officer; Data protection in individual business processes of housing companies; Information obligations towards persons affected; Compliance with technical and organisational measures and deletion concept.
content.title_en: Privacy in the housing industry - including help online

metadata.authors: Schweißguth, Harald; Hummel, David; Hoffmann, Jan Heiner; Schmidt, Fritz

content.text: Myth Gender: a world history of female power and powerlessness. Rich material of comparative cultural myths and ideas about the female body through the centuries, in which male dominance and feelings of powerlessness are shown and which still shape the gender relations today. A basis for today's gender debate. (2)
content.title_en: Myth Gender: a world history of female power and powerlessness

content.text: Human defense: fundamental questions of an embodied anthropology. With the advances of artificial intelligence, the digitization of the world of life and the reduction of the mind to neuronal processes, man appears more and more as a product of data and algorithms. We understand ourselves in the image of our machines, while, conversely, we raise our machines and our brains to new subjects. Against this self-requiring of man, philosopher and psychiatrist Thomas Fuchs sets a humanism of embodiment: our physicality, vitality and embodied freedom are the foundations of a self-determined existence, which the new technologies only use as a means instead of subjecting themselves to them.
content.title_en: Defense of Man : Basic Questions of an Incarnate Anthropology

content.text: Poor Economics : plea for a new understanding of poverty. The groundbreaking book of Nobel economic prize winners. A malnourished man in Morocco prefers to buy a TV than food. Absurd? No. The economists Esther Duflo and Abhijit V. Banerjee arouse worldwide attention because they show: Our image of the poor is a cliché. And we have to radically rethink if we want to solve the problems of inequality. For their research on the fight against global poverty, Esther Duflo and Abhijit V. Banerjee were awarded the Nobel Prize in 2019.(Verlagtext)
content.title_en: Poor Economics : plea for a new understanding of poverty

content.text: The climate-dirty lobby: how politicians and economic leaders sell the future of our planet. At the latest since "Fridays for Future" the topic of climate change has been recognized as one of the most pressing problems of our time. However, despite clear commitments to the goals of the Paris World Climate Agreement, we are far from achieving them - why? Their arguments are crude, their finances opaque, but their influence extends to governments. Climate change-ceptics and lobbyists of the fossil industry are active not only in the US but also in Europe. Their goal: torpedo climate protection laws, promote the burning of fossil resources and encourage states to exit the Paris World Climate Agreement. This book shows with which strategies, networks and arguments the climate protection brakes fight against European climate protection policy. The authors explain why Germany really misses its climate targets and which interest groups build our future.
content.title_en: The climate pollution lobby: how politicians and economic leaders sell the future of our planet

content.text: The digital education revolution: the radical change of learning and how we can shape it. In "Dichter, Denker, Schulverager" (ID-A 37/11), educational expert Dräger had already outlined "Ways from the educational crisis", now he is doing butter with the fish with colleagues Müller-Eiselt. Her credo: There is also "no stop button" in the education sector for digitization. Therefore, one must influence the development - in view of its shadows too -. The authors have changed themselves especially in the USA and generalize their findings for school and academic education. The advantages of digital education over traditional teaching forms: the simultaneous training of masses of learners around the world; the extreme individualization of content; online cooperation through networks: "WeQ instead of IQ". The authors also do not play down the dangers of big data, the revolutionary role of the teachers associated with digitalization has already been shown by the two media researchers who have influenced the wider world (U-R) on the basis of their digital education.
content.title_en: The digital educational revolution: the radical change in learning and how we can shape it

content.text: To the unknown: a journey into history. From the South Sea Islands to Baku, from Singapore to Cornwall, Haiti or New Zealand: this is a pearl of a history book, disguised as a travel book. Infinitely curious, with stupendous historical knowledge and at an age when he and his colleagues have nothing to prove, Davies is the most amusing travel companion on the streets into the history of our world.
content.title_en: To the Unknown: a journey into history

content.text: Genetic engineering in plants : opportunities and risks. Review (ekz): Focused presentation of the use of genetic engineering in plants. The authors explain the molecular genetic foundations and the essential methods of the production of transgenic crops; they also provide an overview of concrete projects in plant cultivation. An essential part of the book deals with the discussion of possible risks of genetic engineering. The authors, experts engaged in research and teaching, try to counter the often indisputable and emotional discussion with rational and differentiated considerations and to check fears for their factual relevance." (2001). For the 5th edition of this textbook (4th edition 2012, 3rd edition 2007) the author has revised all chapters and inserted new and improved, mostly colored illustrations. New is a chapter on genome editing, the last chapter on the future perspective has disappeared.
content.title_en: Genetic engineering in plants : opportunities and risks

content.text: Laravel : the comprehensive introduction : the framework for modern PHP development. Laravel is a powerful and flexible PHP framework and is considered one of the most popular. Nevertheless, it does not (yet) have the radiance like the well-known JavaScript libraries. This title is also the only one on the topic displayed here. The book offers an introduction at an increased level and also displays practical applications. The first chapters cover the basic components (routing and controller, templates with blade, databases and eloquent, front-end components and user inputs etc.). The following chapters then deal with rather unusual components (Artisan and Tinker, Request, Response and Middleware, Container, Data Storage, E-Mail, Collections etc.). At the end of the chapters there are tests and summaries. Prerequisite for a profitable reading are knowledge in an object-oriented programming language, especially PHP, basic knowledge of the Model View Controller (MVC) and experience in the work with template engines. Thus the relevant target group is smaller.
content.title_en: Laravel : the comprehensive introduction : the framework for modern PHP development

content.text: Digital Business Development: the impact of digitalisation on business models and markets. Digital Business Development - Managing the agility of the digital age -- Start-ups and companies at the time of digital disruption -- Digital Ecosystems -- Digital Business Innovation Culture – Focusing on people -- Design Thinking – A buzzword, or is there more behind it? -- Data as a driver of digital transformation -- Artificial Intelligence and the influence on business -- Digital Transformation – Transformation of companies in the digital age How are business models designed in the digital age to drive the development of companies and strengthen positioning in the market? How do companies prepare for the new business opportunities to remain successful in the long term? The book deals with these questions in the context of digital transformation. It is a good description of change management, examples of organizational models and design thinking that enable digital business development. This book links the knowledge of experts from practice and science who have accompanied many companies themselves. Business managers learn more about the targeted use of technological innovation and IT managers as a convincing way of perceiving their role as business driver systems in business business business.
content.title_en: Digital Business Development: the impact of digitalization on business models and markets

content.text: The EU is in crisis mode. After decades of success, the Union now seems to be threatened for the first time in its existence. But is the current situation really so extraordinary? Based on the latest research and archive research, Kiran Klaus Patel re-tells the history of European integration in the Cold War and thus also immerses the developments of the present. The EU's self-image could not be more radiant. It stands for peace foundation, economic growth, a policy oriented on values and an unstoppable growing Europe. And in retrospect, it seems that its predecessor organisations have created all this entirely out of themselves and almost inevitably. In his book, which is picked up with surprising insights, Kiran Klaus Patel questions this standard narrative and makes clear that this exaggerated self-image unnecessarily exacerbates today's crisis perception, because it is considered as new and threatening, which has always existed. A critical story that asks how the EU really emerged – beyond the wish-image of the political Sunday speeches.
content.title_en: Project Europe : a critical history

content.text: Deeper Learning in School: Pedagogy of the Digital Age. Deeper Learning describes an innovative pedagogy by which pupils become active designers of their learning in the context of the digitalisation of passive knowledge recipients. The book explains the learning-heoretical background of deep learning through vivid texts, graphics and examples. A model of deep learning developed for the German cultural area builds on existing school practice and consistently thinks about it with the possibilities and opportunities of the 21st century: After a first phase of knowledge acquisition on different channels, pupils work in a second phase co-constructively and co-creatively, then in the third phase to show authentic achievements that become visible not only in the classroom but also shape the world of life. Thus, the learners develop not only Agency, but also the 21st Century Skills communication, collaboration, critical thinking and creativity.
content.title_en: Deeper Learning in School : Pedagogy of the Digital Age

content.text: Digitalization: the HR management of the future. This volume forms the conclusion of the series "Kohlhammer HR Competence", which deals with current challenges of human resources. This volume deals from different perspectives with the digitization of the working world. The progressive digitalization also changes of course the personnel management. While classical administrative tasks are simplified, at the same time space for new strategic and value-added processes is created. However, in order to make this space really meaningful and objective, it is necessary to carefully plan strategically what effects digitalization has for leadership, development, personnel diagnostics and many other fields of personnel management. Only a reflective bypass with digitalization can also open up its possibilities. This volume provides suggestions for this reflection.
content.title_en: Digitalization : HR management of the future

content.text: The basics of school quality; 4: Teacher professionality and school quality. Teachers play a central role in the learning of pupils and have a lasting influence on their learning development. In this respect, the ›factor teacher‹ for quality teaching must be placed at the centre of the considerations. Volume 3 on teaching quality has already looked into the question of how teachers can design good teaching. In this volume, the focus is on the question of how teachers learn and how they can continuously develop their professionalism. In this context, the structural framework and social contexts as well as the support possibilities for professional professional training of teachers are taken into account.
content.title_en: Basics of School Quality ; 4: Teacher Professionality and School Quality

content.text: Understanding autism : External and internal views. The topic of autism has experienced a considerable economic boom in recent years. Not least, a wealth of autobiographical reports by those affected about autistic perception, thinking and acting has called into question the widespread clinical-pathologising view of autism. The book aims to understand the views of autistic persons and to compare them with scientific findings, especially from the field of neuroscience. Neuroscientific findings shed a completely new light on the abilities and intelligence of people in the autism spectrum. The characteristics developed here are then examined by autistic persons themselves - to some extent from the "inside view" -: perception particularities, unusual learning behaviour, focused thinking, difficulties in communication and social interaction etc.
content.title_en: Understanding autism : external and internal views

content.text: 26 April 1986: Chernobyl: Consequences of a catastrophe. The Chernobyl reactor accident of 26 April 1986 had an impact on the whole world. It strengthened discussions about the possibilities and risks of high technologies, among others. This is the main thread of this book. The author begins with the description of the technology used in Chernobyl, the causes and the course of the disaster in the vicinity. The following chapter on the international effects of the disaster, but above all on the reactions in the FRG and the GDR. Another chapter is dedicated to the devastating disaster of the Schweizerhalle near Basel, also in 1986. In this case toxic substances from the company Sandoz fell into the Rhine and caused a great fish death. The author comes back again and again to accidents with high technologies, such as Fukushima, Harrisburg, Bhopal or Schweizerhalle, and corrects misassessments and false facts. His book can only be a "moment recording" (the last word of the text) - because the discussions about the events of Chernobyl, especially their long-term consequences, will accompany several generations and accompany them for a long time.
content.title_en: 26 April 1986: Chernobyl: consequences of a disaster

content.text: The basic work for report makers and report recipients. It is not well-ordered for business communication. Managers are tormented by overloaded reports and bored in incomprehensible presentations. Some of them feel really bothered. The authors of reports and presentations, for their part, complain that their superiors do not bother to study their elaborations in detail. Be quiet about using themselves in the dashboards they design. Something seems to go wrong with business communication in general, if stations are not understood and recipients do not feel well-served. Business communication is too inefficient – both what is reported in writing and what is presented live. It is simply too tedious to refer to its information from reports, presentations and dashboards. Lack of standards in visual communication are an important reason for this inefficiency. Lack of notation standards result in every chart and table being different. The reader can't see how it works out in the future, and how the patterns are re-readed.
content.title_en: Filled, framed, shaved: how visual uniformity improves communication with reports, presentations and dashboards

content.text: Behind the border, before the law: an ethnography of the European migration regime. Behind the border, before the law is a sociological contribution to the debate about migration management and belonging. The study describes the handling and control of "unwanted" immigration, but also how the right of residence is applied, ignored, reinterpreted and idealized, and how law and law application allow and limit the scope for action of migrants alike. Responsibility is often difficult to locate in the dense regime of control bodies. The authors illuminate the perspectives of state actors, NGOs, people with precarious legal status and various institutions in eight European nations and come to the important conclusion that all involved actors are repeatedly trapped in cafkaesque time loops and formality and informality are not counter-poles in Western Europe, even in Western Europe.
content.title_en: Behind the border, before the law: an ethnography of the European migration regime

content.text: Generation Z in the four-country comparison: an empirical comparison of Germany, the Netherlands, Austria and Switzerland. Generation Z – born in the early 1990s – is currently entering the world of work, and is influenced by it, but also shapes it itself. This publication deals with the phenomenon of Generation Z – which is a survey of 3,610 young people of Generation Z in Germany, the Netherlands, Austria and Switzerland. This publication is based on the master's theses by Sabrina Eilers, Martin Elizen, Kathrin Meier and Claudia Karaca, written at the Chair of Business Administration, in particular Organization, Human Resources and Information Management at Saarland University in Saarbrücken. Among other questions, what does Generation Z expect from working life? - Why does it decide for or against an employer? - In which office does it want to work? - Does it really dream of the large-scale office and the desk sharing? - What are the dreams of life? - What does Generation Z expect from working life? - What should she decide for or against an employer? - What does she want to work? - What does she have fear? - What is the whole generation policy?

content.text: Introduction to the real process calculation of combustion engines: Modeling and calculation program. Introduction -- The zero-dimensional one-zone model for the real process calculation -- For characterizing combustion engines -- Comparison between calculation and measurement The real process calculation is an important simulation tool for detecting and evaluating improvements in combustion engines. Extensive measurements can be partially dispensed with. Calculation results can also be used for dimensioning components. The real process calculation here is based on the so-called zero-dimensional model. Material data and other piston-way-dependent sizes are approximated with simple polynomial equations. The combustion process and heat transfer are taken into account. Thus, for four-stroke motors, the thermal efficiency and pressure flow can be calculated in the working room. The calculation model is programmed in Excelâ VBA. The calculation program and the source code are open on the Internet. The content Introduction.- The zero-dimensional one-zone model for the real process calculation.- Characterization of combustion engines.- Comparison of combustion engines. The target groups The book and the calculation program are addressed to students of the technical disciplines, the engineering department of the Karlsruhe/Circombining company.
content.title_en: Introduction to the real process calculation of combustion engines : modeling and calculation programme

content.text: Methods of Behavior Biology. A bird sings in the morning because... - it becomes bright. - its hormone status changes. - it thus keeps rivals away from its territory. - partners are lured by the singing. Due to the variety of levels at which animal behavior is scientifically investigated, behavior biology becomes a very lively and modern discipline. In this textbook the authors explain the basic scientific methods of qualitative and quantitative recording of behavior. Here, descriptive and experimental experimental approaches are taken into account. The wide spectrum of modern behavioral biology is illustrated by examples from the current research. This second edition has been updated and didactically re-examined. An extended author team takes into account the numerous findings of recent years and highlights important topics in boxes briefly and pre-pregnantly. The authors Marc Naguib is head of Behavior Ecology at the University of Wageningen in the Netherlands. His research focuses on acoustic communication especially in songbirds, social behavior and influences of the conditions during early development on behavior. E. Tobias Krause is a scientist at the Institute for Animal Welfare and Animal Conservation of the Friedrich Loeffler Behifungs- Institute of Behinders- Behaviours- Behaviours.
content.title_en: Methods of Behavioural Biology

content.text: Game Design and Production: Basics, Applications and Examples. Prof. Gunther Rehfeld teaches at the Department of Media Technology at HAW Hamburg and conducts research on online computer games, dramaturgy and activating game formats. This basic textbook for prospective computer game designers first explains the general contexts of human play. The author also considers the transitions to the new networked media and communities in the so-called virtual spaces. In the course of the book, the state of the art regarding the production of computer games is described, whereby the game development (game design) is discussed as well as the programming, functioning and job profiles of the game industry. Here, the focus is on general principles, as computer technology is subject to a very rapid change. The book refers in boxes and comments to relevant literature, games and other media and is intended to stimulate the deepening of the area. In addition, the book provides an overview of the forms of online and offline games and clarifies core concepts of the setup of computer games.
content.title_en: Game Design and Production : Basics, Applications and Examples

content.text: Authenticity: the career of a longing. Authenticity is the catchphrase of the hour, the longing of the present. Politicians should appear authentically. Novels tell unfiltered about true life. And in the existence of the individual, authenticity promises genuine happiness. But what is the price? Do we really want to experience our bosses unrequited - or rather professional? If we are always looking for our 'true self', where does the desire for change and the ambivalence of life remain? And to whom do we want to give the interpretation authority about what 'authentic' German is? Erik Schilling follows the rise of the cult of authenticity in society and culture and shows that his dominance leads not only to boring art, lay-like politicians and unhappy people, but also to intolerance and division. By also discharging the ground of the longing for authenticity philosophically, he pleads for a free relationship with the contradictions with which the world and we all are afflicted.

Helpful for readers is that the individual chapters have a common system of education. content.text: Many actions of daily life (e.g. online shopping) are carried out via the Internet. The data used (e.g. bank data) are often of interest to criminals and therefore must be protected against spying. This topic is addressed by J. Steinberg: "Cyber security for dummies" (ID-A 25/20) or K. Mitnick: "The art of anonymity in the Internet" (ID-B 4/18). The book is addressed to readers without any prior knowledge, who often cannot assess whether, for example, when switching to a new version of the operating system or when switching to another operating system, the additional advantages offered are convenient, but perhaps with a loss of security. The same applies to data storage, e.g. in the cloud. The author gives extensive information on data protection and shows how a largely anonymous data traffic on the Internet is possible. Password protection and the use of voice assistants are also addressed in detail. Didactically well-structured. Many images are highlighted.
content.title_en: Unmarked on the Internet

content.text: OpenLDAP in practice: the manual for administrators. This book provides a detailed description of how to extend and perform your LDAP server's functionality by overlays, including a multi-master replication and the integration of Kerberos. All steps on the way to a redundant OpenLDAP IBM structure including the use of Kerberos IBM are described in detail. The main focus is on managing the command line. As you prepare for the upcoming OpenLDAP version 2.5, you can see a chapter on dynamic POSIX groups, which can be set up with OpenLDAP version 2.4 now, so you can use them in their full functionality in version 2.5. In a separate chapter we will look at the subject of monitoring, because a service like LDAP should never remain without monitoring.
content.title_en: OpenLDAP in practice : the manual for administrators

content.text: Windows Server for Dummies. Windows Server is a Microsoft server operating system based on Windows 10; the importance for modern computerization lies in the assurance of Microsoft that the delivery with security updates is guaranteed until January 2029. Literature on Windows Servers has been discussed here only rarely, to mention among others Carlo Westbrook: "Windows Server 2019", Thomas Joos: "Microsoft Windows Server 2019", Jörg Schieb: "Windows Server 2019" and Peter Kloep: "Windows Server 2019". Existing titles show how to work well with Windows Server and sets priorities at GUI (graphic user interfaces), console and PowerShell. In addition, readers learn how to set up an Active Directory, what to do with group guidelines, how to create a domain, how to virtualize with Hyper-V, and how to secure data and monitor processes. - The book here does not require any special prior knowledge and is therefore suitable for beginners*
content.title_en: Windows Server for Dummies

content.text: Light and Shadow : Cinema Diary 1929-1945. Victor Klemperer's diary notes about his visits to the cinema at the beginning of the Tonfilm era. From the beginning, the Cineast is witnessing how the technical innovation in 1929 is entering Germany. He often goes to the cinema several times a week. First critical, he is soon caught up in the new possibilities. But the National Socialists are continuing to collect the medium, Klemperer finally banished completely from the cinema houses by the cinema ban for "non-Aryans" 1938. But even that can't keep him away. The passionate confession of a cinemaman who shows us the sound film as a mirror of German history with all the light and shadow sides.
content.title_en: Light and Shadow : Cinema Diary 1929-1945

content.text: Pest and Corona : Pandemics in history, present and future. Learning from past pandemics to be better positioned for future with new ideas, so that trade, change, contacts and communication as life elixirs of the (global) communities remain in these times of crisis, the authors demand (historians, doctors). (2 S)
content.title_en: Pest and Corona : Pandemics in history, present and future

content.text: The psychology of the pig dog : In 6 steps from good intent to new habit. Daniela Bernhardt works as a lecturer in the teaching of study competences and has compiled this book from the findings of her "pig dog seminars". After a short introductory chapter in which the inner pig dog is defined and demarcated by procrastination, a very detailed theoretical part follows, in which various psychological aspects of the pig dog are explained vividly and with many examples. The final part offers a practical step-by-step guide, favorable habits and thinking methods to establish. The chapters can be worked through chronologically, but can also be used to look at individual aspects. Summaries, reflection questions and further sources (both as literature data and QR codes that lead directly to online sources) complement the chapters. The book is explicitly aimed at students, but the presented methods can also be transferred to any other professional or private situation, therefore recommended for acquisition. content.text: The world after Corona: the risks of capitalism, the side effects of the state of emergency and the society to come. Also in the year two of the Corona pandemic, the virus, which has now cost more than 1.5 million people their lives, determines the political, economic and social reality in many parts of the world. The crisis of the world economy triggered by the lockdowns is no less serious. The situation is very different: in some countries of Asia and Africa the virus has been successfully stopped, often at a high price. Europe and the USA try to control the second wave of infections with massive emergency measures, while in some countries of Latin America COVID-19 is raging almost unlimited. At the same time, the hope is growing that vaccines could herald the beginning of the end of the pandemic - even if doubts are appropriate here, not only in terms of global accessibility.
content.title_en: The world after Corona: from the risks of capitalism, the side effects of the state of emergency and the society to come

content.text: GANs with PyTork themselves are not discussed: a comprehensible introduction to generic adversarial networks. Literature on the new algorithm GAN (Generative Adversarial Network) developed in 2014 for the field of deep learning has hardly been discussed. Only D. Rao mentions this topic on the sidelines, but the focus is on program creation with PyTork. This book is aimed at readers who want to familiarize themselves with the basics of the new algorithm by simple examples. It is clear that GANs are based on two neural networks (generator, discriminator) that compete against each other, mostly with the aim of generating realistically-looking photos, videos or texts. These products are generated by the generator and checked by the discriminator and rejected in poor quality. The author starts with an introduction to the PyTork and then puts a focus on the creation of human faces. The book is well-structured, closes almost every chapter with a formulation of learning objectives. The contents of the book was tested with a group of developers. All tools are available for free.
content.title_en: Programming GANs with PyTork: an understandable introduction to Generative Adversarial Networks

content.text: Citizens to power: how our democracy works better. The political system in Germany is increasingly suffering from a lack of reform and the resulting problems. This leads to a growing political discontent among citizens. Above all, the omnipotence of the parties causes growing displeasure. Jörn Kruse analyses the problems of our political system and derives from them catchy, profound reform proposals. In his Democratic Reform concept, he advocates the strengthening of the division of powers and a clear limitation of party power. Citizens directly elect the parliament, the government and a newly established citizen's Senate. The Bürgersenat takes over the role of the Second Chamber in the legislation and appoints the heads of non-political state institutions. Kruse succeeds not only to uncover central systemic problems but also to point out a well-founded solution. (publisherswerb)
content.title_en: Citizens to power: how our democracy works better

content.text: Mobile apps with SAP Cloud Platform Mobile Services. For consultants, software architects and developers, it has always been important to know and train on current technologies and trends. The challenge of creating and operating mobile software solutions includes various aspects: from data integration, to potential network topologies, security and authentication issues, to an appealing user experience (UX) and the actual programming of the app. This guide provides you with a detailed insight into mobile application development in the SAP context. SAP presents a wide range of services for the agile development of smartphone apps around the SAP Cloud Platform Mobile Services. You will get an overview of the possibilities of this platform for hybrid and native apps and their integration into the traditional IT system landscapes. The author pays special attention to the configuration of the SAP Cloud Connector as well as the SAP Mobile Cards app and the native SDKs for iOS and Android. The SAP Mobile Development Kit for the cross-system creation of apps completes the plant. Setting up the SAP Cloud Platform Mobile Services Micro-Apps with SAP Mobile Cards Apps for iOS/SDDroid and the SAP Cloud-Data

content.text: Patient safety: the guide to prevention and improvement. To ensure patient safety is not just a catchword, but a reality that is lived! Patient safety must be the top principle of any medical institution! However, treatment procedures are becoming increasingly complex, overcrowded ambulances are leading to hectic and stress or knowledge is not being used. These and many other reasons can endanger patient safety. In this plant, the top health care risks are presented and concrete indications are given about their best possible prevention. Among other questions, the following questions are answered: Which instruments and measures can be used to promote patient safety? How can patient safety be sustainably changed? How can patient safety be measured? What must an organisation do to promote patient safety accordingly? What can employees in the healthcare system contribute to supporting patient safety? What must be done to ensure that students are already confronted with this issue? What can patients and their relatives contribute to increasing their safety?
content.title_en: Ensure patient safety : the guide to prevention and improvement

content.text: Optics and Photonics. Completely revised new edition of the authoritative basic textbook on optics and photonics - comprehensively revised and expanded with a new chapter on metamaterial optics. Optics is one of the oldest and most fascinating sub-areas of physics and firmly anchored in the curricula of physics studies. It deals with the spread of light and phenomena such as interference, refraction, diffraction and optical images. Photonics includes optical phenomena, which are primarily based on the interaction of (quantized) light and matter, and deals with the understanding and development of optical components and systems such as lasers, LEDs and photonic crystals. In a proven manner, the completely revised and extended new edition of the "Saleh/Teich" gives an introduction to the basics of optics and photonics for students of physics and related sciences. Detailed explanations, about 1000 illustrations and the mathematics necessary for quantitative penetration enable a deep understanding of all sub-areas of classical and modern optics. * Comprehensive and understandable: all basics of optics and photonics are united in one work. * Written by outstanding didactics with extensive research of the visual phenomena are extended with a broad scientific approach.
content.title_en: Optics and photonics

content.text: Bioeconomy in self-study: value chains and innovation potential. This volume discusses the economic sectors involved in the value chains of the bioeconomy from raw material to the end product. The focus is on the biomass producing industries and the diverse manufacturing industry including waste management. This is followed by an analysis of how far the bioeconomy is already established in the various sectors and in which sectors it has future potential. By 2050, the change in raw materials from fossil to sustainable raw materials is to be largely completed in accordance with the Paris climate agreement. Companies still based on fossil raw materials will therefore increasingly have to adapt to the coming bioeconomy. Participants will learn to recognise the challenges herein, but also the great potential for innovation and the improvement of competitiveness, which lies in the link between the value chains involved. 1 Introduction and terms -- 2 sectors of the bioeconomy -- 3 value chains -- 4 Competitiveness and innovation potential.
content.title_en: Bioeconomy in self-study: value chains and innovation potential

content.text: State and Constitution in the digital constellation: selected writings on the change of politics, state and constitution through the Internet. Digitization is changing society, but also the state and constitution. In eight chapters, Ingolf Pernice captures the essential aspects that shape this change. The essays from 2013 to 2020 are devoted to the structural change of the public and politics, the change in the relationship between the state and citizens through the opening of statehood and the new role of state and constitution in global society. The background is the emergence of a »constitution of the Internet« as a result of the development of the »people's law of the network«. Digital instruments could help to facilitate democratic normization on the global level. The final attempt to reconstruct the state in the »digital constellation« leads to reflections on how self-determination can also be organized as global citizenships.
content.title_en: State and Constitution in the Digital Constellation: Selected writings on the change of politics, state and constitution through the Internet

content.text: Patents in practice: Introduction for engineers and scientists in the first handling of technical patent rights. This book provides an insight into the exciting world of technical patent rights. After a short introduction, it explains the structure of patent specifications to the reader. Further topics are aimed at persons who wish to acquire further knowledge in the patent system, e.g. in a specialist department or a company without a patent department to take over further tasks. content.text: Methods of microbiology: a practical manual. Isolation and cultivation of bacteria -- Identification and differentiation of bacteria -- Mushrooms -- Molecular biological methods -- Light microscopic methods. This textbook provides answers to questions such as "How does this microbiological method work in a practical way? content.text: Federal Democracy : Governing in the field of tension between interdependence and autonomy. In the comparative doctrine of government, the "federal democracy" is not considered as an independent type. Therefore, the relationship between federalism and democracy remained largely unexplained. This book defines this relationship as a field of tension. Democratic legitimacy sets the autonomy of the rulers, in federalism requires coordinated governance. In comparison with various forms of federal democracy, the author analyses the causes and consequences of these tensions. He shows which institutional conditions trigger self-enhancing dynamics and which enable actors to adapt their strategies and learn to deal with tensions. Starting from his concept of federal democracy, he criticizes a technocratic interdependence management and populist ideas of "unbundling" and pleads for democracy-compatible forms of coordination in federalism.
content.title_en: Federal Democracy: Governance in the Interdependence and Autonomy

content.text: The cradle of Islam: Mohammed, the Koran and the ancient cultures. "The renowned ancient historian Glen Bowersock, in his small masterpiece, says goodbye to the image of warlike Muslims from the Arab desert who storm the Old World. He shows how much Arabia has long been part of the ancient world, and in brilliant close-ups he draws a refreshingly different picture of the birth of Islam. Ancient Arabia was fiercely fought between Christians, Jews and polytheists, and the three great powers Ethiopia, Byzantium and Persia took advantage of this rivalry. Thus, the Byzantine emperor probably supported Mohammed's Hijra from Mecca to Medina, where Muslims should keep the Persian-friendly Jews in check. When Muslims came to Jerusalem in 648, they were opened without battle to defend the Christian hegemony over the city against Jews and Persians. But why did Byzanz see the Muslims on his side? In one chapter we approach the prophet Musaylimagance, one of the many competitors Mohammeds. Why did the Christian leaders of the latter leave behind the Christian leaders?
content.title_en: The cradle of Islam : Mohammed, the Koran and the ancient cultures

content.text: The Bauhaus : Workshop of Modernism. The Bauhaus - today a synonym for architecture and design of classical modernism - was founded in Weimar in 1919 by Walter Gropius. Among the members were Wassily Kandinsky, Paul Klee, Oskar Schlemmer and Ludwig Mies van der Rohe. They all contributed to developing a holistic concept to combine art and design, craftsmanship and technology. Winfried Nerdinger is knowledgeable about the central ideas and the form of teaching at the Bauhaus and vividly presents the most important persons and products as well as the political and economic contexts.
content.title_en: The Bauhaus : Workshop of Modernism

content.text: Internet linguistics: a textbook and workbook. Rapid technological developments, the expansion of digital communication and its effects on language and interaction create a dynamic data pool for one of the most exciting areas of modern linguistics: Internet linguistics. The aim of this textbook is to provide comprehensive information on this lively research area and to show how language and communication science methods can be combined in a meaningful way to analyse the peculiarities of linguistic-communicative action on the Internet. In a reader-friendly way, current research results are prepared didactically with numerous application examples and exercises. The book is conceived as an introduction and is equally suitable for seminar design and self-study. About the 1st edition: "Description and analysis of Internet-based forms of language use are always linked to concrete visual material, so that conceptual and illustrative material enter a successful synthesis here as well.
content.title_en: Internet linguistics : a textbook and workbook

content.text: Digitalisation with work and vocational training is a sustainable way of shaping the work and vocational training. What is the significance of digitalization for the education and training of the electrical, information, metal and vehicle professions? The use of digital technology leads to a major change in the activities and workflows. At the same time, the employees of these professions are particularly involved in these changes by using and manufacturing digitally innovative products. The present collection is divided into three parts. The section on resource-focused technical work is about the design of sustainable production, service and repair processes: How can digital technology be used to work resource-efficiently and efficiently? Under the heading "Smart Learning", the authors discuss the success of didactic transformation and new teaching methods for commercial-technical schools. Furthermore, the volume deals with computer science as a cross-cutting discipline of all digitization processes: How can computer education be designed in vocational education and training, although computer science is not a binding subject?
content.title_en: Making digitalization sustainable with work and vocational training

content.text: The New German School - Phenomena and History : Sources and comments on a central music aesthetic controversy of the 19th century. Berlioz, Wagner and Liszt are considered protagonists of the so-called "New German School". This phenomenon formed the crystallization point of a paradigm shift in the 19th century, which had an impact on European cultural history from the point of view of music criticism to the point of European cultural history. In an unprecedented way, the meaning of music and society were linked, bundled into large utopian designs and – constructed history. - The present edition of the sources gathers contributions from contemporary German, English and French-speaking music magazines from the mid-19th century. The polemic debate surrounding the "New German School" is documented and comprehensively commented on with over 150 articles. The period from 1845 to the death of the ideological initiative force, Franz Brendel, was opened up in 1868. The polarity of the "Fortschrittspartei" and "Conservative" that still exists today, as well as the self-intelligibility of the term "New German School" are critically questioned, differentiated and presented in new light.
content.title_en: The Neudeutsche Schule - Phenomena and History : Sources and comments on a central music aesthetic controversy of the 19th century

content.text: Continuous power-based textile technologies for lightweight structures in large series: Results from the BMBF composite project KonText. The book presents the final report on the KonText joint project. The main concern of the joint project was the reduction of the costs of FVK components by providing a textile manufacturing process and the subsequent production of power-driven thermoplastic fibre composite components. The entire process chain was provided by the C-Faser optimization, through the production and structural simulation of power-flow-compliant textiles as well as plant development and testing up to the production of components using classic large-scale series technology "Reforms". The joint project was carried out within the framework of the research campus initiative "Open Hybrid LabFactory". The editor Prof. Dr.-Ing. Klaus Dilger studied mechanical engineering with a focus on manufacturing technology at the TU Munich. After his diploma in 1987, he was a scientific assistant and academic council member of the Chair of Joining Technology at the TU Munich, where he has been involved in research and teaching with the entire manufacturing process. In 1997, Prof. Dampiltechnik was appointed to the University of Applied Sciences and Technology.
content.title_en: Continuous textile technologies for lightweight structures in large series that meet the requirements of the flow of power: Results from the BMBF-Verbundprojekt KonText

content.text: Diversity and security in the neighbourhood: Conflicts, trust and social cohesion in European cities. The quality of life in cities is shaped by their diversity of social situations, lifestyles, values and cultures. In cities, strangers encounter each other in close spaces and are forced to deal with each other. When social fault lines and processes of social disintegration are shown, social diversity can question valid norms and values and be linked to uncertainties and conflicts. The danger is that conflicts of use and intergroups as well as everyday irritations and different behaviours experienced in urban districts are perceived and discussed in public discussion too quickly as regulatory disruptions or even threats to security. This volume therefore combines contributions from scientists and practitioners from urban planning, housing management, community and integration work, and regulatory and security authorities for a positive and productive approach to issues of diversity and security with examples from Belgium, Germany, Finland, the Netherlands, Austria and Portugal.
content.title_en: Diversity and security in the neighbourhood: conflicts, trust and social cohesion in European cities

Nature is to be regarded as an elementary health resource, because movement in a natural environment has proven positive influences on human health and is summarized in the concept of "Therapeutic landscapes" in many ways. Natural spaces offer an important, economically measurable resource for strengthening health, especially for an ageing society. The author prepares natural, social, and humanities studies for a broad range of readers understandably, vividly and clearly. At the same time, he provides suggestions for a conscious use of the sensitive resource landscape and for regular nature observation. The content Therapeutic landscapes, introduction to a concept of health-promoting places On the landscape and health concept Human-place-binding Landscape preferences, landscape and forests as a health resource The target groups of students and lecturers in the fields of landscape planning, nature conservation, geography, health sciences and environmental psychology, medicine as well as -pedagogik Professionals in these areas and landscape architecture, environmental economics as well as gerontology Therapeutic landscapes Therapeutic landscapes of the forest community of Augsburg and the University of Augsburg teaches of Germany have a PhD.

content.text: The basics of data analysis with R : an application-oriented introduction. This book provides an application-oriented introduction to data analysis with the free statistical environment. It also covers descriptive analyses as comprehensively as inferential statistical analyses. In addition to classical univariate methods, the book takes into account nonparametric tests, resampling methods and multivariate statistics. It also covers the many possibilities to prepare data and create diagrams. The statistical procedures are explained using examples and illustrated in many places with diagrams. The book is aimed at all those who want to get to know R and use it in concrete tasks without having to have previous experience with command-controlled programs or programming languages. For the fifth edition, the book has been fully updated: It now refers to version 4.0.0 of R, and the selection and presentation of additional packages used has been adapted to the dynamic development. The plant genome and its inheritance -- polyploidization and its effects on the plant genome -- Structural chromosome mutations -- Repetitive elements and the plant genome -- The genome size of plants is dynamic -- In the age of genome sequencing and pangenomics -- Glossary. The cells of each living being contain the genetic information in the form of DNA, also called genome, which is determined to a large extent by the appearance and function of an organism. Also in plants, this is not different. The genetic information is not static, but changes with great dynamics. In this essential you get a broad overview of the processes that change the plant genome during evolution. What is polyploidy and why can it promote the development of genes with new functions? Why are some plant genomes huge and others tiny, though they contain almost equal numbers of genes?
