content.text: What happens when the rain falls? : Introduction to hydrology ; 1 Table. The contents of the volume refer exactly to the question posed by the title, i.e. it follows the "way of the drops of water from the clouds to the earth and back again". The water cycle is presented as the result of a variety of individual processes, as a closely linked network of various causes and effects. The textbook chooses a "flowing organic" way to introduce into its knowledge area, deliberately abandoning the otherwise usual theoretical-systematic form of representation. With reference to special publications, the application-oriented, water-economic part of hydrology has been omitted. (3) (LK/UL: Kiener)
content.title_en: What happens when the rain falls? : Introduction to hydrology ; 1 table

content.text: Web-based application development : the most important technologies for web applications at a glance. This book is intended for all those who want to be fundamentally and comprehensively involved in the development of web-based applications. Based on a seminar series of the same name, the author introduces you to the respective technologies that can be used in a modern 4-tier application. The aim is to provide you with a comprehensive understanding of the development of so-called enterprise applications, which is profound but does not go too deep into the matter. At the end of each section you know which technologies are available, how these technologies work and what technology has what advantages.
content.title_en: Web-based application development : the most important technologies for web applications at a glance

content.text: A new house of books: [Architecture competition for the 4th extension of the Deutsche Bücherei Leipzig]. Founded in 1912, the Deutsche Bücherei Leipzig - together with the Deutsche Bibliothek Frankfurt am Main and the Deutsche Musikarchiv Berlin - collects all German-language publications without any problems. Its holdings grow every day by 24 shelf meters of books. Since the magazines are used up, an extension building for the new additions of the next 20 years is now to create space and host the German Book and Writing Museum. In a Europe-wide competition of over 200 participants, Stuttgart architect Gabriele Glöckler won the prize with a city-building, architectural and functionally convincing design. Her concept "Content-Hülle-Umschlag" is the now fourth extension of the Deutsche Bücherei. The book portrays the current building and its surroundings, documents the architectural competition and its results and presents winners in detail in text and image.
content.title_en: A new house of books : [Architecture competition for the 4th extension of the Deutsche Bücherei Leipzig]

content.text: Task collection on the basics of electrical engineering : with solutions and detailed solutions ; the proven help for students of electrical engineering and other technical courses starting from the 1st semester. Publisher's text: This extensive task collection, which is now available in the 11th edition, is a proven help in understanding the basics of electrical engineering.
content.title_en: Tasks on the basics of electrical engineering : with solutions and detailed solutions ; proven assistance for students of electrical engineering and other technical courses from the 1st semester

content.text: Black box - white cube. "Among the different pairs of contrasts that have structured the culture of the twentieth century, there is also the contrast between gallery space and cinema room. One belonged to the high culture, the other to the mass culture. Under the economic primacy of art production - individual artists create unique works - the artists spent a lot of energy experimenting in the twentieth century with what could be placed in the neutral setting of the White Cube: they said themselves off the flat right-angled frame by opening the third dimension; they covered the floor with their works, they attached them to the ceiling, etc. In other words, to try an analogy between the artwork and a digital computer, one could say that in modern art both the "physical interface" and the "software interface" of the artwork were not defined, but were released for experiments." (Lev Manovich) Lev Manovich, professor of media art and theory at the Visual Arts Department of the University of California, San Diego (USA).
content.title_en: Black box - white cube

content.text: Training program for the prevention of depression in adolescents : LARS&LISA: A desire for realistic vision & lightness in everyday social life. The manual describes a ten-session group program for the universal prevention of depression in adolescence. LARS&LISA (a desire for realistic vision & lightness in everyday social life) serves to build functional cognitions and promote social skills. Both are important resources in dealing with stress, as they are especially seen in puberty. A lack of these skills increases the probability of the occurrence of depression and other psychological problems. Through its primary preventive approach, LARS&LISA can be carried out with all adolescents aged between 12 and 16. The training program consists of the building blocks »Formulation of personal goals«, »Cooperation between cognitions, emotions and behaviour«, »Exploration and change of dysfunctional cognition«, »Self-security training« and »Training of social competences«. Numerous working materials and detailed instructions for the implementation of the training facilitate the implementation into practice.
content.title_en: Training program for the prevention of depression in adolescents : LARS&LISA: A desire for realistic vision & lightness in everyday social life

content.text: Strategies for urban regions in the 21st century: Recommendations for a field of action of national importance. Urban regions are centres of economic power, locations of research and development, focal points of living and focal points of cultural and social change. They are the carriers of economic growth, technological innovation and social development in Germany and Europe. For a new orientation and concentration of state and municipal spatial development policy, the urban regions have to assume a decisive role. In recent decades, urban regions have been able to support regional and even transnational balances through growth surpluses. However, structurally-induced growth weaknesses, demographic changes and the crisis of public finances have fundamentally changed the situation. A working group of the Academy of Spatial Research and State Planning and the German Academy of Urban Planning and State Planning call for this writing and the theses to initiate the necessary changes to the institutional reorder of the urban regions and to combine this strategic reorientation with a reform of the financial constitution at all levels.
content.title_en: Strategies for metropolitan regions in the 21st century : Recommendations for a field of action of national importance

content.text: The study of the theoretical physics / Torsten Flüssbach; 2: Electrodynamics. This textbook gives an introduction to electrodynamics as offered at the university in the cycle "Theoretical Physics". The author has attached particular importance to a clearly legible, comprehensible and manageable representation. The individual steps are presented in such detail that the reader can understand them without any major difficulty. The preparatory part I presents the mathematical aids needed for the following in compact form. The treatment of electrostatics (Part II) and magnetostatics (Part III) are combined. Based on experimental findings, the field equations are motivated and the various methods for their solution discussed in detail. Building on this, Part IV deals with Maxwell's theory, which describes the coupling of electric and magnetic fields in the time-dependent case. The properties of the Maxwell equations are examined, in particular the general solution and the behaviour under Lorenz transformations as well as the Lagrange formation. Part V deals with applications such as the hollow space waves, the radiation accelerated charge, the frequency of the spectrum of the spectrum of the spectrum of the electrons and the spectrum of the spectrum of the spectrum of the spectrum of the spectrum of the spectrum of the spectrum of the spectrum.

content.text: "The IT security in the company is a key element of the strategic approach. Bursch is able to communicate with all the key aspects of an efficient IT security concept. In spite of increasing risks in terms of IT security, many companies are not being smartly affected by the resulting damage - although they have suffered high financial damage, for example due to viruses, worms, Trojans and not least criminal employees. To avoid the enormous range of potential dangers and the resulting financial disadvantages, IT security and the use of tactical security measures have become a priority. For IT management as well as for the entire company. Daniel Bursch succeeds in showing pioneering knowledge about the explosive topic of "qualified IT security". His book shows above all that a complete IT security concept must be considered holistically and cannot be limited to technical measures such as firewalls, access control systems or cryptography. Especially the management of reliable business processes and their support by secure IT services are important factors in the strategic approach. Bursch communicates expertly and compactly all the essential aspects of an efficient IT security concept. A comprehensive checklist catalogue is also suitable for the implementation of a business.
content.title_en: IT security in the company : basics, strategies, check-up

content.text: The volume discusses a number of procurement issues that are of current relevance to local authorities and their companies as "public contracting entities" in terms of public procurement law (public procurement law) and inter-municipal cooperation. The volume deals with the local design options for public-private partnerships (public-private partnerships) and, in the light of the current discussion at EU level, the scope of tendering obligations. The scope of the concept of public contracting authorities plays a particular role in this respect. Furthermore, the question of tendering obligations and their exceptions to PPP models and privatisations is addressed. Further discussion blocks are the awarding requirements for the award of service concessions and the scope of the scope of the award law in the field of inter-municipal cooperation in the field of supply and disposal. Finally, the admissibility of the inclusion of such non-contracting aspects in service descriptions is discussed.
content.title_en: Design options for public contracting authorities from the point of view of procurement law : current procurement requirements for public-private partnerships (PPPs) and inter-municipal cooperation

content.text: This book takes up the most important conditions of living in old age and undergoes a systematic evaluation. This analysis begins with the historical roots of institutional living and leads through the central aspects of acute living to special housing offers and forms with stationary care. Among the most important perspectives of future living in old age are new concepts of residential-related, supportive everyday aids and the further development of communal living forms up to a continuous strengthening of living in care. The book is aimed at all experts who deal with the current questions of living in old age and the assessment of its development perspectives.
content.title_en: Living in old age

content.text: The Islamic civilization, especially its Arab core countries, is in a deep crisis. It is still superior in every respect in the Middle Ages to Christendom, since then the region of the Near East has stagnated and does not participate in the development that the West has undergone from the early modern era. This is more evident today, after the end of the Cold War and under the conditions of accelerating globalization, than ever before. The result is political radicalism occurring in the religious guise, on the one hand, timid attempts to join the modern age, on the other. The historian Dan Diner, one of the best connoisseurs of the complex Middle Eastern conflict situation, manages convincingly to name the causes of this development blockade. The diagnosed standstill is due less to Islam as a religion than to specific social, economic, cultural and political circumstances of the Near East. They lead to an all-time presence of the sacral even in areas from which it has been displaced elsewhere on the way to modernism. Historically actuating and out of a lack of knowledge of the realms, a new field of view, a new time opened to a single-minded, non-sounding time.
content.title_en: Sealed time: about the standstill in the Islamic world

content.text: Energy transition in heavy seas? : Conflicts over offshore wind power use. On the one hand, offshore wind energy has great potential for ecological conversion of the energy system. On the other hand, the planned wind farms in the German North and Baltic Sea are fiercely controversial. It is noteworthy that the wind farms do not trigger the "classic" economic-ecology conflict. On the other hand, regional structural change conflicts as well as internal ecological conflicts are at the centre of the debate, e.g. about wind farms in marine protected areas or the course of cable paths through the Wadden Sea, where nature conservation and climate protection collide. The authors investigate the opportunities and problems of offshore wind energy. They examine the possibility of viable conflict solutions, in which they consider above all the action dilemata, into the conflict parties such as island and coastal communities, environmental associations, offshore wind farms operators and political decision-makers.
content.title_en: Energy transition in heavy seas? : Conflicts over offshore wind energy use

content.text: Islam in the classroom: impulses for educational work. Ayse does not participate in swimming lessons, Mehmet does not participate in class trips and Nuray sleeps almost during Ramadan. More than 700,000 students in Germany are Muslim faiths. They are no longer a minority and shape schools and residences through their own values, traditions and rituals. Life and learning, however, do not always run without conflict and means new challenges for teachers, parents and students. With the initiative "Vonzeichnen Lernen - Praxisforum Schule und Islam", the Körber Foundation, together with the Cultural Ministerial Conference of the Länder, asked educators for their experiences and successful, practical ideas and projects to deal with these challenges. Whether theatre plays, the deliberate thematicization of differences in teaching, the research of their own family history or the developments of intercultural school profiles - educators between Schleswig-Holstein and Bavaria have developed projects that can be used for dialogue.
content.title_en: Islam in the classroom : impulses for educational work

content.text: The Gothic architecture. Who is not speechless in the miracle of a Gothic cathedral? And who did not guess about the performance of the great builders and the medieval building huts? But what is so sublime as a secret in stone existed before as a draft on parchment. The copper engraving cabinet of the Academy of Fine Arts in Vienna is fortunate to have the world's largest collection of original Gothic architectural drawings from the 14th and 15th centuries. This invaluable inventory - 428 drawings - was first comprehensively worked out by art historian Johann Josef Böker. His research is a cultural historical event of the first rank: it puts the history of Gothic architecture on a new foundation. No researcher will be around it in the future, nor should any lover of Gothicism miss the magnificent volume that now makes the treasure publicly accessible: on 464 pages the architectural plans are presented in four-colour printing, accompanied by historical black and white photographs of the buildings. - - - The restored and digitized collection was awarded the European Heritage Award/Europe Nostra 2003 and was included in the Register of the Worldory.
content.title_en: Gothic architecture

content.text: The distribution effects of the Hartz IV reform: results of simulation analyses. The adoption of the Hartz IV law has come up with fierce protests. A central point of criticism is the reduction in benefits associated with the abolition of unemployment assistance. Does the reform actually lead to substantial income losses and the feared impoverishment of the long-term unemployed? On the other hand, to what extent are positive effects also arising from the fact that for subgroups the new unemployment benefit II (Alg II) is higher than the previous unemployment assistance? These questions are examined in a methodically differentiated way by the study. Based on the legal regulations Becker and Hauser develop a simulation model, which uses alternative microdata sources (EVS and SOEP) to examine whether and, if necessary, to what extent a claim for Alg II exists. The result of the simulation shows that there are reform winners and losers. Those who cut better or worse are differentiated according to East and West Germany, gender, household type, employment constellation in the household and age groups. Finally, the income distribution rates are determined by the income distribution.
content.title_en: Distribution effects of Hartz IV reform : Results of simulation analyses

content.text: Amendment of the Land Planning Law in North Rhine-Westphalia. As in the other countries of the Federal Republic of Germany, the Land Planning Law in North Rhine-Westphalia has been adapted to the new Land Planning Law (ROG). This process was accompanied by a working group of the Land Labour Community North Rhine-Westphalia of the ARL. After the members had given early recommendations on the short-term adaptation requirements, the focus of the further work was on the need to implement the amendment in the medium term. The focus was on the review of the Land Planning Concepts and Instruments, the design of the targets, the integration of the Land Development Programme and Land Development Plan North Rhine-Westphalia, the advantages and disadvantages of regional land use plans, considerations on technical contributions to the spatial-related specialist planning and the continuous reporting (monitoring) within the framework of the reorientation of the planerical activity. The members of the working group have broadly and directly contributed the results of their consultations in the context of hearings, seminars and discussion forums on the change-making discourse at the Land level.
content.title_en: Amendment of the Land Planning Law in North Rhine-Westphalia

content.text: Great Britain : England, Scotland, Wales ; [Geography, History, Economy, Politics] ; with 22 tables. The national customers of the WBG are characterized by scientifically sound information, a high degree of reliability and good legibility. This also applies to the newly published volume on Great Britain, which is based on the author's 3 decades of scientific engagement with the region. The central themes of the book are the historical and economic development of Great Britain, the urban and rural structures and the geological natural space. Wehling (last BA 2/02) shows how a classical industrial country in Europe has become a pioneer in the deindustrialization and exporter of services. The book is very appealing with 144 illustrations, including many statistics and maps. An extensive literature directory completes the high-quality volume, which can already be regarded as a standard work. There is currently nothing comparable on the German book market. Very suitable for students and students of secondary school II. (2 S) (Rolf Ingo Behnke) Standard work on Great Britain, whose central themes are historical and economic development, urban and rural structures as well as well as the geological region (Rolfo).
content.title_en: United Kingdom : England, Scotland, Wales ; [Geography, History, Economy, Politics] ; with 22 tables

It is designed for practitioners and students who want to learn about the mode of action, switching and calculation of hydrostatic and pneumatic work and control elements. content.text: The questions are known and new at the same time: Where does the human soul live, how strong is human freedom of action? Are there any mental processes at all, as we place them in our human image in the general way? Is there the immaterial soul? Or is everything just the result of the neuronal apparatus and man rather nonfree in his power of judgment? The author, mathematician and Christian, has already been concerned with body-spirit issues (BA 3/02, 11/98, ID 48/00). This is about the conception of man before the back of a new neurobiological materialism ("brain and consciousness", BA 9/94; "consciousness", ID 12/96; B. Libet: ID 11/05) and in view of new, still mainly experimental computer technologies such as the quantum computer. The third part of the book is concerned with the synthesis of materiality and immateriality: life, mind and soul. Thus the book is in the neighborhood of J.C. Eccles (BA 3/95), H. Hinterhuber (HID/02) and the reader.
content.title_en: Brain, Soul and Computer : the Man in the Quantum Age

content.text: Outlook : [Functions, settings, practical solutions; fast solutions for everyday life & work]. Search - Find - Solve, this is the motto of the new "practice reference" series from Data Becker. It delivers immediately implementable solutions to all important application and function areas. An extensive practical index allows direct access to relevant user questions about Outlook 2003 (XP and 2000). For all functions there are practical examples suitable for everyday use. A grippy book format with high use value, also a work tool for the desk. (2)
content.title_en: Outlook : [Functions, settings, practical solutions; quick solutions for everyday life & profession]

content.text: Assessment of the carcinogenicity of formaldehyde is produced in high quantities worldwide and is contained in many consumer products. The substance is also produced in small amounts in the cell metabolism of humans and animals. Formaldehyde is harmful to health, it irritates the mucous membranes and can cause cancer in the nasal cavity when it is inhaled. This is the result of an evaluation of new studies presented to the public by the Federal Institute for Risk Assessment today. The institute considers it to be sufficiently proven that the substance in the nasal cavity can cause tumours when inhaled, and therefore proposes a change in the applicable classification. The harmful effect of formaldehyde is concentration-dependent. eIn case of room air values of or below 124 micrograms formaldehyde per cubic metre, there is virtually no longer any cancer-caking effect to be expected, says the president of the Federal Institute, Professor Dr. Andreas Hensel.
content.title_en: Assessment of the carcinogenicity of formaldehyde [CAS No. 50-00-0] : Report on the assessment of the carcinogenicity of formaldehyde

content.text: Questionnaire : a workbook. This book is a "practice book" in the truest sense of the word. It is intended to help researchers who want to use social science surveys in their empirical research. It is intended to provide help in the development of their questionnaires, in concrete and detailed terms. The book simulates questionnaire consultation, as the author has done for many years at the Center for Surveys, Methods and Analysis (ZUMA) in Mannheim, very practical and written in such a way that readers can work with it when developing a questionnaire, with many examples of how to do something wrong and how to do it right. After a short introduction to the cognitive psychology and communicative foundations of the survey, a variety of methodological aspects of a questionnaire are worked out, from types of questions, types of scales and the formulation of questionnaire questions to a good cover page, to survey aids and to the layout of questionnaires, all illustrated by examples from survey practice.
content.title_en: Questionnaire : A workbook

content.text: Tourism : a geographical introduction. The latest volume of the series, which is mainly designed for the university sector, deals with leisure and tourism from the point of view of geography. The presentation follows the classification into the central chapters: research approaches and methods, typology of the standard tourist, travel behaviour of the Germans, tourism as an economic factor, destination types in tourism and future perspectives. Clearly structured, well-prepared basic knowledge, which not only students of human geography but also representatives of other disciplines dealing with the subject can be provided. (3)
content.title_en: Tourism : a geographical introduction

content.text: Audio circuits for sound technology, studio and PA. The 10 year old first edition of the tape for experienced electronic based artists (BA 12/96) was mainly adapted to the current component situation (circuits with semiconductor components no longer available on the market were sorted out), otherwise only slightly changed. The tape, equipped with numerous circuit diagrams and circuit layouts, is still integrated into the fields of theory, practice and measurement technology. The author describes requirements for amplifiers and signal paths that enable optimal sound quality. The findings from this flow into the practical replica instructions for power supplies, microphone and line preamps, equalizers and small mixers. Where "circuits around audio technology" (BA 8/05), whose predecessor title "Audio circuits par excellence" (BA 11/04) or R. Sontheimer (BA 3/05) are well used, the current title can be well supplemented. The first edition should be replaced.
content.title_en: Audio circuits for sound technology, studio and PA

content.text: Silicate inks at the building : Advantages of silicate inks for the new and historical building ; application and execution of paints, decorations and wall paintings. Silicate paints are environmentally friendly and have considerable advantages in terms of processing and durability. However, they also require specific expertise, which this volume conveys to the reader. From the material characteristics to the working techniques to the aging behaviour and special application possibilities such as wall paintings, the author spans the content sheet. In addition to sound basic knowledge, he provides extensive practical instructions for dealing with this special coating material
content.title_en: Silicate inks at the building : Advantages of silicate inks for the new and historical building ; application and execution of paintings, decorations and murals

content.text: AGRO-Gentechnik: the seed of evil: the creeping poisoning of soil and food. Collection of articles by expert authors on the use of genetic engineering in agriculture and the influence of large chemical companies on politics. (Hans-Ulrich Struck) Despite warnings from consumer associations and protests from farmers, genetic engineering is on the rise in Europe. Lobbyists are specifically influencing the legislation in Berlin and Brussels. In the USA and Canada, however, patented genetically modified seeds have been grown almost everywhere for 10 years. The balance sheet is sobering: pesticide consumption has increased, yield has fallen, transgenic plants are spreading uncontrollably. Worse still: American farmers are bound to seed contracts by large chemical companies, which they can cost in case of non-compliance the existence of the farms. The report here printed here by the independent consumer organization Center for Food Safety, Washington DC, on the machinations of the Monsanto group contains every amount of explosives. The articles come from professionally versed authors. Overall a clear statement against the use of genetic engineering in the agricultural ruck and lobby technology in the large group.
content.title_en: AGRO genetic engineering: the seeds of evil : the creeping poisoning of soil and food

content.text: Renewable energies: with energy efficiency at the energy turnaround. The authors are leading scientists of the Wuppertal Institute for Climate, Environment and Energy. In a series-typically concentrated style (see also Stefan Rahmstorf: "Klimawandel", BA 6/06) they treat the various forms of renewable energies from solar heat to tidal power plants and address the numerous obstacles that stand in the way of global development. The second focus is on the urgently necessary increase in energy efficiency without which the enormous problems of the coming decades will not be solved. A narrow pocketbook, which is picked with numbers and facts, convinces by interdisciplinary approach and sharp-minded-critical but hopeful analyses. It is equally suitable for demanding presentations (elementary by Paetec "Energy", in this No.) as well as for generally interested readers who want to inform themselves well. "Renewable energies" (BA 11/07) brings more details, but does not offer this systematic approach. Further useful C. Morris: "Zukunftsenergieren" (BA 7/05). For as many libraries. With the use of renewable energies, the use of renewable energy as well as well as many as possible, the use of renewable energy sources.
content.title_en: Renewable energy : with energy efficiency to the energy transition

content.text: The forgotten imagery of Christian art: a guide to understanding the symbolism of animals, angels and Mary. "On the subject of Christian symbolism in art, there is hardly any other book that brings so many and so many useful indications to understanding medieval theology and image symbolism. "Doris Schmidt, Süddeutsche Zeitung What does the Pelican stand for in Christian art? Why do we meet Mary so often in a closed garden? And who are the angels with the four wings and the four heads? This book, written in a vivid way, leads through the diverse animal, angel and Mary representations of Christian art, explains their symbolism and makes known its ancient and biblical sources.
content.title_en: The forgotten imagery of Christian art: a guide to understanding the symbols of animals, angels and Mary

content.text: Charles Darwin. More powerful and systematic than J. Browne (see this no.) the author puts the philosophical aspects of Darwin's life and work into the spotlight. The long-term effects of his theories on the humanities and human sciences, such as philosophical anthropology or epistemology, are described. The close link between natural sciences and philosophy is presented as defining and characteristic of his worldview and the formulation of his findings. Engels also deals with the controversy and confrontations around Darwin's theories. They illustrate the misinterpretations and misunderstandings, in particular the misleading equation of Darwinism with Darwinism, as well as the polemic reductions of his theses on stereotyped Floskeln, such as the "war on existence". A sophisticated, also typographically-pressed biography with an extensive literature directory as well as persons and registers of subjects. (2)
content.title_en: Charles Darwin

content.text: Adobe Photoshop Elements 5.0 : a visual introduction to digital photography. Another well-structured comprehensive introduction to the management and post-processing of digital images with Photoshop Elements 5.0. All topics are explained clearly and comprehensible for beginners, without exuberant jargon of expertise. The author is here in detail both with the basic functions and with the increasingly popular RAW editing. With understandable explanations of all important functions and many (by all means colored) sample illustrations. All examples are easily understandable. The book is opulently equipped with over 400 pages and 770 color illustrations and is designed for beginners in digital photography. The only criticism point: with the price without CD supplement. In addition to R. Klassen (BA 3/07) and complementary to G. Heimann (BA 7/07). (2)
content.title_en: Adobe Photoshop Elements 5.0 : a visual introduction to digital photography

content.text: The hunt for love: Heinrich Mann and the women. His comprehensive monograph of 1992 (see BA 2/93) leaves Jasper with a specialized presentation which can be documented in detail and in detail, as Heinrich Mann's work from the very beginning (extremely contrary to his rather homoerotically tuned brother Thomas) focuses on femininity, the "hunt for love", which was better known as sex as a significant element of life and fruitful stimulant of artistic work. And that his work is constantly dominated by the massive self-interesting exploitation of autobiographical amours and affairs. In an extremely vivid, almost exciting way, Jasper draws works and acts, and reads them in a well-founded manner, an artist biography in the mirror of empathetically sketched life-courses of many women. Less literary-oriented than the last published man-biographies (see P. Stein: BA 11/02 and M. Flugge: BA 7/06), the almost roman, figure-rich-colored depictions are already widely used in a more general manner than the latter.

Often used material values, constants and conversions of units as well as the properties of the chemical elements are compiled in tables to ensure quick access. This work summarizes mathematical, physical and technical formulas in a bank. Compact and handy are the essential connections explained and illustrated in overviews and many pictures. content.text: MediaPhotography - analog and digital : terms, techniques, web. Digital photography is always understood in current literature as DIGITAL photography. This book consciously tries to lead to a better understanding of modern photography by combining classical with digital technology, for example, to simulate depth of field or to correct typical - analog and digital - image errors, just as the present-day "discovery" of the classic darkroom techniques in digital image processing is in focus. In addition, special aspects of digital photography such as noise and dust correction, copyright issues and the possibilities of the "digital negative" of a raw file are presented. In this context, professional software such as Phase One as open source software such as gimp 2 is depicted. TOC:Preface.- History of photography.- Physical and chemical foundations.- Contrast control in analogue photography.- Basics of digital photography.- Digital image processing.- Black and white with digital index. The digital- Ink.

content.text: The basics of the classic TRIZ: A practical textbook of inventive thinking for engineers. Every person is an inventor! The author presents in this book the development and results of the TRIZ method for solving inventive tasks. TRIZ has its origins in the former USSR and accumulates the experience in the development of many thousand inventions from the patent portfolio of the whole world. The reader is presented in a vivid form the key ideas, methods and examples of TRIZ method. Thus, he gets the opportunity to acquire the main instruments of TRIZ itself. The second edition has been extended by numerous examples. TOC:Introduction.- Methods of Inventing.- A-Studio: algorithmic navigation of thinking.- Classical navigators of inventing the A-Studio.- Strategy of Inventing.- Tactics of Inventing.- Invention Art.- Development of TRIZ.- Final words.- Installations: Catalogues of Navigators of Inventing in the A-Studio. content.text: Machine tooling 3 : Mechatronic systems, feed drives, process diagnostics. The book is aimed at both students and users who need a comprehensive overview of existing systems when selecting suitable machines. The sixth edition has been reworked and improved with regard to the graphic presentation. It presents the latest developments around the regulated feed drive in all areas of application. The compendium machine tooling systems include five volumes that bundle the increasingly complex matter of machine tooling. The focus of Volume 3 is on the design of mechatronic components, in particular the feed drives used for the generation of highly dynamic drive movements of machine tools. Feed drives are among the main components of machine tooling machines to which high demands are placed regarding their dynamic properties. Large accelerations and speeds are required with low web deviations at the same time. Design aids are presented in the selection and design of important machine components. A focus is on the mechanical and control engineering design of feed drives with direct and conventional drives, and the measurement systems required for positioning.
content.title_en: Machine tools 3 : Mechatronic systems, feed drives, process diagnostics

content.text: Practical information technology with C# : Applications and basics ; with 18 tables. Scientific computing, computational intelligence and computational engineering are central methods of modern information technology. Behind these terms are different concepts of digital information processing, which are used e.g. in the analysis of measurement value series, the simulation of electrical balancing processes or in automatic writing recognition. The author gives a sound presentation of the theoretical foundations and the software technical implementation of these methods using concrete code examples in C#.
content.title_en: Practical information technology with C# : Applications and basics ; with 18 tables

The thematic elaboration of this book is designed in this way, so that CNC beginners are also well addressed. This book is accompanied by a CD-ROM which is useful in the development of the individual NC programs (Betr.-System: Windows XP. The runtime of this software covers 60 days from the installation date. All course examples developed in this book are based on this software and lead the learner systematically up to a specified level of performance.

The well-known author explains after some basic information and terms some simple and frequently occurring measuring instruments and measurements, afterwards even more special measuring instruments as well as devices in the field of electrical engineering (especially installation technology). The texts are very well understandable and vivid (with many illustrations). The purchase can be recommended everywhere, especially since such a practical book for such a large reader circle has not been published for a long time. (1) Basic information and terms, simple, frequently occurring measuring instruments and measurements, more special measuring instruments and devices from the electrical industry; for electronics and electricians in the profession and hobby. content.title_en: Who is who in the world of Jesus?

content.text: The Internet - Education - Community. Information technologies, especially the Internet, are becoming increasingly important for people's lives and working environments. Whether it is about learning and playing or maintaining social relationships, the new media are an integral part of this. The volume takes stock of some of these areas and asks how our lives will change as a result of the growing presence of the Internet.
content.title_en: Internet - Education - Community

content.text: Ingenious women: famous inventors from Melitta Bentz to Maria Curie. Everyone now knows that women as well as men can invent machines and other useful things and that this was not easy for them in the past due to the social obstacles. The author presents here, based mainly on extensive patent research, in rapid succession a wide range of inventions and ideas that come from women. The large number of inventors comes from Great Britain, also the described period is limited to the period from 1637 to 1914. Furthermore, as the German subtitles associate, it is not only about technical achievements such as dishwashers, corset constructions, fold-up fins or the coffee filter invented by Melitta Bentz, but also about creative entrepreneurs such as Margarethe Steiff, new concepts in the field of education as with Maria Montessori, scientific discoveries such as with Marie Curie or pacifistic ideas like with Bertha von Suttner. Informative is a chronological list of women who have been acquired. (3) Interestingly acquired patents.
content.title_en: Genial women: famous inventors from Melitta Bentz to Maria Curie

content.text: Made in Germany : best of contemporary architecture. Klappentext: Inovativ, unconventional and with a critical view, the band documents the exciting diversity of contemporary architecture in and from Germany. A high-profile jury of professional journalists and creative observers from the worldwide architecture scene has selected and evaluated outstanding Bauwerrke, which are presented and commented on here using texts, photos, floor plans and plans. The best architects are still presented; short interviews, essays and a special on concrete as material of the year round off the concept of "Made in Germany - Best of Contemporary Architecture" as a new voice of architectural criticism. Categories among others: Bauwerk des Jahres – 1. Platz: Jewish Centre in Munich (Wandel Hoefer Lorch) German architects abroad - 1. content.text: Metzler-Lexikon literary symbols. The novel lexicon, which is useful for text interpretation, shows important literary symbols in German literary history and their respective horizons of meaning. (Ronald Schneider) A symbol lexicon on German literary history is a novelty, and this with good reason, because the variety of literary symbol references is almost infinite. Nevertheless, there is a basic set of symbols, often used throughout the centuries, with a historically limited horizon of meaning, from the "evening" as "symbol of age and death", but also the "threat and limitation" to the "cypress" as "symbol of mourning, death and immortality". In this respect, such a lexicon - with all its incompleteness in principle - makes sense and offers valuable orientation aids, especially for text interpretation. For every larger stock of reference works and means of information on (especially German) literature science highly recommended. (2 A)
content.title_en: Metzler-Lexikon literary symbols

content.text: Where is it going to God? asked the little piglet : a book for all those who are not fooled. The little piglet and the little hedgehog had always believed that they could not go any better. But then someone sticks a poster to her house overnight, on which it is written: "Who does not know God, something is missing!" So they set out to look for God... Where does it go to God?, asked the little piglet humorously to clarify the three world religions Judaism, Christianity and Islam. The question whether a non-religion child "something is missing" is answered from the perspective of worldly humanism: "And the moral of the story: Who does not know God, does not need him..."
content.title_en: Where is God going? asked the little piglet : a book for all who are not fooled

content.text: Urban Living: History, Urban Design, Perspectives. Urban Living is again in conversation IBM architects, planners and investors promote new and latest urban housing types and town houses: >>Townhouses<<, stacked duplex flats, city villas, high-rise apartments, lofts and more. Often it is overlooked that we can look back on a long tradition of demanding urban housing. For the first time IBM has presented an interdisciplinary team with regard to Germany, but also to the most important developments in European abroad IBM a comprehensive history of this upscale urban living extending to the 16th century. The study of urban building qualities and the history of the use of the housing types provides the basis for the current discussion about >>new< qualities of urban living historically and gives it fresh impetus. A research project of the Desert Red Foundation.
content.title_en: City Living : History, Town Planning, Perspectives

content.text: Europe's urban system between metropolitanisation and globalisation: profiles and development paths of the metropolitan regions of Europe in structural transformation to a knowledge-intensive economy. The EU economic area is today characterised by a "metropolization" of the economic development and innovation potential, i.e. the selective concentration of knowledge-intensive economic activities in the metropolitan regions and metropolitan areas of Europe. At the same time, the metropolitan areas act as the main hubs of the global economic integration of Europe. In this book, the different sectoral profiles and development paths of the metropolitan regions and metropolitan areas of Europe are worked out in structural transformation to the knowledge-intensive economy. It is shown that services are by no means the sole determining component of this structural change and research-intensive industries are an equally significant part of this process.
content.title_en: Europe's urban system between metropolitanisation and globalisation: profiles and development paths of Europe's metropolitan regions in structural change to a knowledge-intensive economy

The manual describes in detail and practical terms the individual building blocks of a program for the prevention of eating disorders in schools. The target group are pupils who do not yet suffer from eating disorders, but because of their age are a risk group (11–13 years). This program aims to build a positive attitude towards the participants' own figure and healthy eating and movement behaviour. content.text: Methodical development of technical products : Methods are flexible and appropriate to the situation. Development of technical products is far more than design and design. Value management, customer requirements, corporate design - only a few keywords that describe the complexity. If the available time is measured only in months, then new, systematic methods for organizing product development are required. This book focuses on the description and networking of proven working methods in product development. The methods are described in their structure and mechanisms of action, not as 'recipes', but as a meaningful chain of questions and alternative ways of answering these questions. This brings to the fore methods of less complexity, thereby supporting the necessary application flexibility. For the selection of methods and adaptation, effects and side effects of the methods are described and more complex methods such as scenario technology, QFD, TRIZ and FMEA are presented in a specific application situation. The appropriate approach results from the optimal combination of the individual methods, flexible application and adaptation to the framework conditions. The development manager can thus flexibly optimize his approach. The good response to the book made a second edition necessary, in which the application knowledge is based on a further extended one.

content.text: The wet mining: exploration, extraction, preparation, evaluation. The book is intended as a textbook for the technical study for students of process engineering/processing technology, mining/district mining and geotechnics as well as as as a technical book for the specialists in the production plants of the gravel and sand industry, in relevant engineering companies and authorities. The extraction of gravel and sand is a significant industry. In Germany over 300 million gravel and sand (preferably wet) are collected and processed annually. This is done permanently in about 1500 plants. Because of the quantitative limitations of each individual occurrence, frequently occurring changes in the raw material condition of the deposits in the mining and changes in the sales possibilities for the products are to be made with great frequency replanning for extraction and processing projects as well as reoptimizations for existing plants. In this situation it is important for all involved in such projects to have methods, data, solution suggestions etc. to be available, with the help of which justified decisions can be taken safely and expeditiously. The first book on the topic - with all aspects of wet extraction methods, data, data, and a comprehensive case study guide to each.

content.text: You have to change your life: through anthropotechnics. In his new great essay on the nature of man, Peter Sloterdijk writes fairy tales: As a critique of the fairy tale of the return of religion one could understand his theses. But religion does not return. Rather, it creates something quite fundamental in the present: Man as a practitioner, than being self-creating through exercises. Rainer Maria Rilke has taken the impulse to such retreats at the beginning of the 20th century into form: "You must change your life."In his plea for the extension of the exercise zone of individuals and society, Peter Sloterdijk drafts a fundamental and fundamentally new anthropology. The core of his science of man is the insight into self-formation of all human beings. His activities constantly re-act on him: the work on the worker, the communication on the communists, the feelings on the feelers. ... It is the explicitly practicing people who represent this mode of existence most clearly: peasants, workers, warriors, writers, yogi, teachers, instrumental virtuostics, and the exercises of this maximum of their human exercises.

content.text: The Western disempowerment: the new order of the world. Russia makes the muscles play militarily in the Caucasus, China grows into an economic giant, India is growing nuclear weapons. These are epochal changes, but Europeans are hard to understand. They react to the industrialization of Asia with debates about loss of prosperity, new wars with moral indignation. Nikola's Busse, correspondent of the FAZ in Brussels, observes in Germany a climate of economic fears that does not in any way meet the political dynamics of world affairs. The upheavals of our time go far beyond the relocation of jobs. In Asia, but also in Latin America, new power centers are emerging that put an end to the centuries-long dominance of the West in world politics.
content.title_en: Disempowerment of the West: the New Order of the World

content.text: Journalism online - Participation or Profession?. Online journalism has long been one of the major fashion topics in the media industry. However, with the decline of the "New Economy", net-based journalism has experienced a deep crisis: many of the online editorial campaigns that were built up with great effort have been re-set or severely exploited in terms of personnel and financial resources. However, the Internet has now reached a new stage of development: with the slogan "Web 2.0", participatory formats such as weblogs and collaborative websites are labeled, which enable users to actively participate in the public sphere in the communicator role. Often in this context, actors, structures, processes and achievements of new forms of current internet publicity are discussed facet-rich. In addition to German-speaking communication scientists, international experts and recognized practitioners also come up with latest developments. Press statements "Rejoicably many articles in the book are used [...]
content.title_en: Journalism online - Participation or Profession?

content.text: The book explains the 'How and Why' of the measurement and analysis of response times for computer-based population surveys. Methods for empirically collecting response times (e.g. active or passive time measurement methods) are explained as well as statistical methods for treating and cleaning the collected response times (e.g. operationalization and control of individual base speeds and statistical identification of invalid time measurements). The book describes many application examples of reaction time analyses from current research practice. Applications from the recruitment and behavioral research and the investigation of respondents' behaviour (e.g. detection of response effects) illustrate the wide range of possibilities open to the evaluation of reaction time measurements for improving survey analyses. Dr. Dieter Urban is Professor of Sociology at the Institute of Social Sciences at the University of Stuttgart. Dr. Jochen Mayerl is a research associate at the Institute of Social Sciences at the University of Stuttgart.
content.title_en: Response times in survey analyses : measurement, evaluation and applications

Only recently has the possibility to use 3D catalogs of normal manufacturers effectively. The reader learns about them from many examples and exercises. He uses the many possibilities of SolidWorks in the field of molding and surface modelling.The entire tool construction up to the derivation of electrodes and drawing creation is carried out for an article - an ice scraper.The numerous exercises are didactically designed so that the reader can use his own construction instead of this article. Any start is possible, since intermediate steps can be accessed from the university server.

content.text: The basic course on plant design: planning and design for every garden style. The fact that the author has taught basic techniques of garden design at a renowned college is clear in this book. In their opinion, each garden owner should become his own garden designer. The necessary textbook has created them. On closely described pages, which are slightly loosened by colour photographs, she gives her knowledge of plants and their competent use in the garden price. Plants are for her design material, whose use must be selected according to shape, texture and color with care. It is also important to take into account the location conditions. Only then is it possible to create planting plans. These plans are decisively influenced by the chosen garden style. Whether elaborate garden in cottage style with traditional stowing discounts or care-free, modern garden with minimalist planting - this basic decision must be made in advance.
content.title_en: Basic course Plant Design : Planning and Design for every garden style

content.text: The author has already published 2 challenging books in the series "Der Gartenprofi" (see "Designing with plants", BA 7/06, and "Hecks and green walls", BA 12/07). In this detailed book he recommends that gardens be included in the garden planning. Introducing the history of the garden from monastery to Schreberg species. He also goes on to the basics of gardening from soil cultivation to harvesting, from mixed culture to crop protection. The book's actual focus is on planning and installation of gardens. Kolb presents practical examples of house gardens of different sizes and uses. He finds examples of themed gardens such as scent and herbs gardens, gardens for nature lovers, gardens for gourmets. The practical work book is equipped with colour photos, construction drawings and planting plans. According to the standard work "Der Biogarten" by M. Kreuter (topped BA 5/09). (2)

The successful and popular Missing Manual series has the aim of introducing entertaining and yet professional into current topics. In the original, it is also very good. And, who would have thought it possible: The German translation keeps the loose tone and the book reads fluently as the original text. The translator is highly praised here. content.text: Common differential equations : an introduction from the perspective of dynamic systems. The book provides a compact and fundamental introduction to the theory of ordinary differential equations from the perspective of dynamic systems in the scope of a single-semester lecture. Beyond the discussion of the basic solution theory and the theory of linear systems, analytical and numerical solution methods, basic concepts of the theory of dynamic systems, stability, branches and Hamilton systems are discussed. The material is illustrated and deepened in detail by means of examples, exercises and computer experiments. The book is particularly suitable for the bachelor's degree program, both during the lecture course of the module 'Common differential equation equations' for students in the 3rd semester as well as for self-study.
content.title_en: Common differential equations : an introduction from the perspective of dynamic systems

content.text: Fire protection in the existing building: wood. The requirements for fire protection in the existing building are in stark contrast to the very abstract demands of the new building standards, which are often arranged for existing buildings. In the everyday renovation case, fire protection measures are the main focus on the one hand and the elimination of concrete danger sources on the other. However, in relation to a building monument in particular, it must be taken into account how far an intervention in the valuable building material may go, so that the monument remains a monument and nothing loses its identity. Special precautions must be taken here in the renovation of wooden supporting and construction structures. The author deals with this problem as well as the absolutely necessary level of safety of wooden structures in monuments. He illuminates the various aspects of equal importance, which must be taken into account both from the point of view of fire protection and the protection of monuments.
content.title_en: Fire protection in the inventory: wood

content.text: Microcontrollers for beginners : Design circuits and program software; [on CD-ROM: sample programs, layout data, schematics, data sheets]. As introductions to microcontrollers, B. Kainka (BA 8/04) and U. Brinkschulte (ID 12/03) were discussed earlier. The present book is very up-to-date. Programming is limited to assemblers - even with regard to the required hardware proximity. The examples of the book are based on the PIC16F876A of microchip. This chip has various interfaces and features, which can be used to present a wide range of functionalities. For programming and debugging, the in-circuit debugger ICD2 of microchip is used free of charge. Microcontrollers are to be used in circuits. The author presents a small development board, with which all examples can be tested in a real environment. - Good consideration is given to the control of displays, the evaluation of digital signals, the data storage in an external EEPROM, the communication with a PC and the infrared remote control of the outputs of a microcontroller.
content.title_en: Microcontrollers for beginners : Design circuits and program software; [on CD-ROM: sample programs, layout data, schematics, data sheets]

content.text: The BMBF funding programme "Research for the reduction of land use and sustainable land management" (REFINA) also addresses the National Sustainability Strategy in its projects. On the way to a land cycle economy and sustainable land management, the financial aspects of settlement development are a central problem. Various REFINA research associations analyse cost structures and develop solutions for the financing of land recycling or for the production of cost transparency in settlement area development. Tools for creating more transparency about the subsequent costs of settlement development at the municipal and regional level are also being developed. It proved to be beneficial that numerous municipalities or regional actors are closely involved in REFINA projects. This volume presents the results achieved in the REFINA projects in expert papers. The contributions focus on methods, characteristics and possible uses of tools for subsequent cost consideration. The publication is rounded off by contributions from external experts with a profunden experience in this current field of research.
content.title_en: Follow-up costs of settlement development : assessment approaches, models and tools of cost-benefit analysis

content.text: Environmental justice and pollution of immissions, based on the example of the city of Kassel. The lack of social differentiation in air pollution planning was one of the reasons for the research project described here at the University of Kassel, which was carried out in 2006/2007 by the Department of Environmental Meteorology (FG Umet) and the Center for Environmental Systems Research (CESR).The aim of the project is to investigate the links between social structure and environmental quality in two city districts of Kassel in an exemplary manner. Kassel is a field of study, as in some other urban areas, it is also possible to exceed the limit value for fine dust pollution and, as a result, it is a plan of air pollution.In the context of this research project, it is primarily about obtaining small-scale data on both environmental quality and social structure, developing research programmes currently in the development process and identifying additional research needs.
content.title_en: Environmental justice and immission burdens, using the example of the city of Kassel

content.text: Afghanistan Code : a report on war, fundamentalism and democracy. Marc Thörner has spent two years researching Afghanistan. 'Embedded' in various armies and alone in the country, he has spoken to military, diplomats, mullahs, judges, politicians, governors, warlords and other people in different parts of the country. Islamic extremism, as his provocative thesis, does not threaten the West. On the contrary, it is an important element to secure Western hegemony.
content.title_en: Afghanistan Code : a report on war, fundamentalism and democracy

content.text: On the way to biopowerful society?: Opportunities and risks of genetic engineering. Numerous research results show that the idea of old genetics, which determines everything by genes, is scientifically at the end. However, the transition from old genetics to new genetics, from genetic determinism to system biological epigenetics is connected with great uncertainties, search processes and reorientations. In transdisciplinary cooperation, the authors analyse the current findings and their consequences in bioethical and risk analysis aspects. A critical view from different perspectives results in a sound overall view, which addresses different fields of application of life sciences. Prof. Dr. phil. habil. Achim Bühl teaches technology sociology with the emphasis on technology assessment and future research at the Hochschule für Technik Berlin.
content.title_en: Towards a biopowerful society? : Opportunities and risks of genetic engineering

content.text: Split cities?: social and ethnic segregation in German cities. Where does the poorer population live, where the foreigners? How have the spatial distributions of both groups changed? What is the relationship between the distributions of the two groups? The analyses in this book are directed to these questions. The social and ethnic segregation in the 15 largest cities of Germany are examined in the period 1990 to 2005. For both groups, the changes in segregation and the proportion of the two groups in the individual districts are represented, documented and explained in coloured maps.
content.title_en: Split cities? : social and ethnic segregation in German cities

content.text: Information and coding : Basics and applications ; with 72 tables. Information and coding are key concepts of modern information technology. This book provides a sound introduction to basics and applications. Apart from the usual upper level mathematics (vector and matrice calculation, elementary probability calculation) no special prior knowledge is required. Numerous images, examples and solved tasks as well as references to applications support the independent development of the teaching material. For the second edition the book was completely revised and extended. References to current applications are made and the implementation of the learned is facilitated by additional examples and tasks. Newly recorded program examples with MATLAB® establish connections to practice.
content.title_en: Information and coding : basics and applications ; with 72 tables

content.text: Calculation of three-phase current networks: Calculation of stationary and non-stationary processes with symmetric components and space-liners. This textbook, which has been developed from many years of lecture activity, describes the most important calculation methods for three-phase current networks in a modern systematic version. The extremely advantageous node-oriented presentation runs like a red thread through the book. The main focus is on the calculation with symmetric components in the frequency range based on the classical node-point procedure and the calculation with space-point components in the time range based on the new extended node-point procedure. For the calculation of any error states (short circuits and interruptions) a new universal procedure is presented with the error matrice method, which can be applied equally to the symmetric components and space-point components. The versions are made more understandable by numerous calculated examples and supplemented by two MATLAB program codes for the calculation of the flow of power and the error matrice procedure.
content.title_en: Calculation of three-phase power grids : Calculation of stationary and non-stationary processes with symmetric components and space-liners

content.text: The new generation contract: social-state renewal in the crisis. The debate about the future of retirement provision does not want to ebb. And this despite the deepest crisis in the history of the Federal Republic. This may be surprising at first glance – but the internal connection between the crisis debate and the future of retirement provision cannot be overlooked: Thus the (partial) privatization of the pension was and is one of those sources that flooded overflowing financial resources into the markets, fueled speculation and thus became a "crisis driver". Secondly, rising unemployment and falling incomes threaten to undermine the income base of the statutory pension and to become the "crisis victim" of retirement. However, a wise retirement policy could play a not to be underestimated role in overcoming the crisis. Do the income of pensioners contribute to stabilising domestic demand. And: The regulation of a flexible retirement age increase to fair conditions instead of the pension with 67, on the other hand, could not only counter the pension-related year, but open up the opportunities for young people to a job in crises. However, in order to make a contribution to the existing age-based insurance system, the new age-based system must be re-applied.
content.title_en: The new generation treaty: social-state renewal in crisis

content.text: Media Resonance Analysis : an introduction to theory and practice. The textbook is aimed at students and practitioners who want to gain an overview of the most important fields of application and the research practice of media resonance analysis. In the first part, the method is classified into the context of the basic research on communication science and application-oriented evaluation research. A case study is used to present the individual research practice steps in the second part.The detailed explanation of the case study and the detailed documented research instrument form a practical handout, which gives a variety of quality criteria to the hand in order to assess and interpret media resonance analyses with knowledge Juliana Raupp is a university professor of journalism and communication science at the Freie Universität Berlin with a focus on organizational communication. Jens Vogelgesang is a scientific assistant in the field of communication science (in particular interactive media and online communication) at the University of Hohenheim.
content.title_en: Media Resonance Analysis : an Introduction to Theory and Practice

content.text: Future-oriented change in hospital management : outsourcing, IT benefits, forms of cooperation, change management. Within the healthcare sector, the hospital sector plays a central role. In recent years, a profound change has taken place. In the book, leading practitioners and scientists show how a forward-looking approach to important issues such as IT solutions, outsourcing strategies, horizontal privatisations as a form of cooperation as well as change management could look like. The book thus provides a broad know-how for administrators and physicians about important areas of modern hospital management.
content.title_en: Future-oriented change in hospital management : outsourcing, IT benefits, forms of cooperation, change management

content.text: Urbanity replanning : Urban planning, urban conversion, urban development. Based on the facts of declining population figures and social focal points in certain quarters of German cities, a team of authors from different disciplines deals with 11 articles on the needs, possibilities and limits of urban planning oriented towards developments. Topics on the problem of "shrinking and perforating" communities are: practical examples of "urban conversion", the need for qualified immigration, the importance of civic engagement, tendencies of "district flight" and the departure from "urban pessimism". Detailed comments and literature at the end of each chapter. Not abstract, but oriented towards individual projects and problems, therefore useful and important not only for planners, but also for interested and committed city dwellers. (2) (Erdmann Steinmetz) Contributions to urban planning and development in Germany in view of declining population figures, social problems and scarce financial resources. (Erdmann Steinmetz)

content.text: Conscience: ethical problems of computer science; biometry - data protection - intellectual property. When dealing with digital technologies every day, we rarely ask ourselves how our actions could affect third parties. This book deals with current problems of responsibility in the digital world. It gathers German-speaking cases on ethical issues of computer science and provides valuable ideas with the presentation of credible conflicts in the fields of data protection, biometry or intellectual property, which encourage further thought.
content.title_en: Regrettably : ethical problems of computer science ; biometry - data protection - intellectual property

content.text: The present guide informs old building owners who plan to convert older oil and gas heating systems to more efficient and regenerative heating systems because of constantly increasing energy prices and for climate protection reasons. (Elke Nibbrig) The author already has 3 titles on old building renovation and modern heating technology displayed here (ID 40/09, BA 3/09, BA 2/09). The present guide informs old building owners who plan to convert older oil and gas heating systems to more efficient and regenerative heating systems because of constantly increasing energy prices and for climate protection reasons. After a short introduction to economic efficiency and environmental protection, wood heating systems, power-heat-cogeneration, heat pump heating, gas heat pump and the combination of solar panels with the heating system are treated. Finally, it is about the optimization of existing heating systems as well as correct ventilation and cooling in heat-insulated old buildings. Intelligently written, with detailed and helpful cost-benefit comparison, diagrams, tables (s sometimes at the limit of readability), useful for example to the user.

content.text: C++ for engineers : learn programming efficiently. The student and practitioner receives solutions from simple and complex technical questions based on sound C++ programming. One focus is on object-oriented and generic programming. The wide range of application examples is easily comprehensible and allows gradually an increase in the level. The book also contains suggestions for further work.
content.title_en: C++ for engineers : learn programming efficiently

The text is minimized, divided into different levels (documents, explanations, comments) and much is conveyed by means of examples and visualizations. A book, which is unique in its didactic concept, is ideally suited for students of the economic and social sciences to introduce the methodology. Books on the subject appear rarely, usually the data analysis is only dealt with briefly in works on empirical social research. For libraries in university locations and large collections elsewhere, since also for interested lay people suitable for browsing and reading. (3)

content.title_en: Kokoschkins Journey : Roman

content.text: The men's crisis and why it is also dangerous for women. Journalist (BA 4/06) does not again explore the soul landscapes of the battered strong sex - for them the crisis of men and of manhood is fundamental, global and highly political. Not only the women's emancipation, but also the economic and ecological faults of time are nagging the identity of men. However, the representatives of "old thinking" do not give up. They become perpetrators, block progress, in the worst case they take hold of (weapon, economic and psychological) violence: "They believe they must wage war because war makes them 'right men' again". The author tries to illustrate the consequences of this "irrational surplus" of maleness as a whole (including women) by means of political "leaders" (Obama, Putin etc.), Islamic "God warriors" and their opponents as well as other representatives of the power elite. The good news of all the bad: The solutions to all the world's problems are present - all the media- all the human rights.
content.title_en: Twilight of the Heroes : the crisis of men and why it is dangerous for women

ClimateCultures: social realities in climate change. For too long it was believed that only meteorologists, marine scientists and glacier researchers were responsible for the research of climate change. But global warming confronts people, cultures and societies with new and still barely understood challenges. Their overcoming is not only a technological but also a cultural task - it affects the lifestyle as well as fantasy and inventiveness. The cultural sciences have the important function here to make the findings of climate research in their social dimension assessable - this is, for example, about generational justice, responsibility, ways out of the guiding culture of waste, concepts of good life, in short: about the conditions of future survival. Renowned authors of cultural studies show in this volume why a change of climate inevitably leads to a cultural change. With contributions by Ulrich Beck, Dieter Birnbacher, Michael Hagner, Nils Minkmar, Birger P. Priddat, Ingo Schulze and others.
content.title_en: ClimateCultures : social realities in climate change

content.text: The book Linear Algebra and Analytical Geometry: the most important in detail for the teaching and bachelor's degree programme. Fischer's standard works on linear algebra (ID 50/08) and analytical geometry (most recently ID 43/91, not shown here) have been reliably accompanying students in basic studies in mathematics, physics and computer science for a long time. The "learning book" here now provides the most important topics for the bachelor's degree programme of these two classics. The presentation is much more detailed and accessible to beginners, the abstract conceptual formations and methods are comprehensively motivated, the basic basic principles are very vivid and detailed and provide numerous examples and illustrations that illustrate the geometric background of abstract concepts. Thus, especially for future or already in the profession, mathematics teachers are particularly suitable for future or existing teachers. The basics are treated, for further topics refer to the classics (see above). The work is better than that of A. Bagspacher (BA 3/04) and this one to prefer tasks on the Internet. For stocks with corresponding target groups priority, otherwise broadly recommended.
content.title_en: Learning book Linear algebra and analytical geometry : the most important in detail for the teaching and bachelor's degree programme

content.text: Just live better : Sustainability as a new lifestyle. The theme of the yearbook "Zur Lage der Welt 2010" (Preliminary edition, see BA 7/09) is "Simply live better - sustainability as a new lifestyle". The prosperity on the go, the future generations have to pay, cannot go on. Our consumption behaviour must change. We need a new culture of sustainability. Well live not at the expense of others! Experts of the Worldwatch Institute describe how such a change could look like. Can be used everywhere for the current discussion. (1 A,S) (LK/F: Themelidis)
content.title_en: Just live better : Sustainability as a new lifestyle
