content.text: Ways to change: how to make social change more successful. Climate change, scarcity of raw materials, financial and economic crisis - the list of urgent global problems to be solved is long. They interlock, fuel each other and are symptoms of a crisis of the entire system
content.title_en: Ways to change: how to make social change more successful

content.text: New ways to venture: Innovation in education, business and society. This book on innovation focuses on two perspectives that have been neglected so far, namely, firstly a critical examination of the idea of innovation and secondly a combination of innovation ideas in a number of important social areas. All contributions address the question from a different perspective: Why innovation? As the financial crisis and its consequences have shown, innovation can become extremely dangerous and cause great damage, especially if it takes on inhumane and unethical traits. Innovation is, on the other hand, crucial for Germany's future. The authors deal with possibilities of innovation in the family, in educational institutions of elementary education, secondary education, at universities, in companies, organizations and in administration. The final chapter brings together all the authors once again and offers a kaleidoscope of proposals and ideas to what is necessary in the future for innovation and how to connect innovation and tradition in a meaningful way.
content.title_en: New ways to do this: innovation in education, economy and society

content.text: BilMoG accounting: short commentary on the annual financial statements and the management report under new accounting law. "The BilMoG is a milestone on the path to internationalisation and modernisation of commercial accounting. The new accounting law has been developed to an equivalent, yet cost-effective alternative to IFRS. Numerous voting rights are abolished, the information content of accounting is significantly increased and the integration with tax law significantly reduced. Thus, "BilMoG" is synonymous with the largest accounting reform since the 1985 Accounting Directive Act. Many questions of interpretation and doubt arise in the application of the law. In their answer, the short commentary offers comprehensive practical support."
content.title_en: BilMoG accounting : short commentary on the annual accounts and the management report under new balance sheet law

content.text: The end of the world, as we knew it: climate, future and the opportunities of democracy. The author duo Claus Leggewie (lastly on the topic of "globalization", ID 23/03 and otherwise journalistic) and Harald Welzer, political professor of the one, professor of social psychology of the other, unites a skeptical view of the possible threats of our Western democracies. Climate change, resource shortage, pollution of the environment, migration movements due to expected floods and desertifications or the overfishing of the seas have built up a destructive potential that can only be defused by the radical change of our lifestyles. The two discuss controversial questionable instruments such as emissions trading, the ideological system competition of capitalism and socialism and the vulnerability of high technology cultures. It is the ridge-walking between the pointed point finger and future-oriented optimism that makes reading exciting and involves the reader as a actor in this scenario. With detailed commentaries and registers. (2)
content.title_en: The end of the world as we knew it : climate, future and the opportunities of democracy

content.text: Nanotechnology in the food sector. So far, only a few nanoscale food additives or food ingredients with such components are available on the Swiss market. Synthetic nanomaterials are additives such as silicon dioxide, carotenoids and micells, which have been used for many years and are toxicologically tested. They enable improved handling, improved optics or an increase in the bioavailability of nutrients. On the other hand, food supplements with nanoscale precious metals with questionable benefits and partly toxicologically questionable properties are offered on non-European markets. This study shows the chances and risks of the use of synthetic nanomaterials in food and food packaging.
content.title_en: Nanotechnology in the food sector

content.text: The study of the end of life is one of the basic tasks of every religious education. It calls anthropological basic constants - such as death - into the consciousness of the people; this is particularly important in a topic that is otherwise marginalized and tabooized. The study of death and death has now found its way into the teaching boards of all school types and federal states. The aim is to convey a thematic reflective ability and corresponding social and self-competences to young people. The volume offers an analysis of the learning conditions, scientific and didactical information as well as material for the religious instruction of upper secondary education and II and the work in the community on all relevant aspects of the topic.
content.title_en: Talking about Death in Religious Education

content.text: The fall of the Islamic world: a prognosis. The Islamic countries unite a religion from which they derive a problematic human and social image: women and most men who do not come from the ruling class are excluded. Unceasing intellectual resources must not be used, which also means that the prosperity of these states is lost. Fundamentalist Muslims consistently interpret this misery as the result of "the hostile politics of the West". Regional and global perspectives are threatening, because the coming together of an anti-innovation culture, a rapidly growing, poor and oppressed population, the slumping oil reserves and climatic problems results in an explosive mixture. Hamed Abdel-Samad ventures a sharp, compelling prognosis for the future of culture, which he himself comes from: the Islamic states will disintegrate, Islam will be a political and social idea, it will be a culture that will fall
content.title_en: The Fall of the Islamic World : a Forecast

content.text: Human Time: Destroy or shape? ; the decisive epoch of our planet. The renowned science journalist Christian Schwägerl (The Mirror) describes why we live in the "Anthropocene", the age of man, in which we fundamentally change the planet Earth at breathtaking speed. Man creates new landscapes, intervenes in the world climate, emptys the seas, creates new living beings. The boundaries between nature and culture disappear. From the environment becomes a "human world" - but it is characterized by shortsightedness and robbery. Are we developing the maturity to use our power for a long future? The renowned science journalist Christian Schwägerl describes why we have long since been in the Anthropocene, human time living in an era in which man is changing his planet at breathtaking speed. The technologies of the modern era have enabled an explosion of production increase, accompanied by dramatic population growth. Rapid climate change, species extinction and an increasingly fragile ecosystem hang like a damoclessword over the unremitten rise of a species that has changed the earth unremitigably. But we can only live in a future, and in a future is not able to rejoy. We can only live in a future in society, but in society.
content.title_en: Human Time : Destroy or shape? ; the decisive epoch of our planet

content.text: User experience design : with experience-centered software development to products that inspire. User experience design process, design process -- idea, idea-finding -- business analysis -- user research -- requirements -- information architecture -- interaction design, interaction design -- information design -- visual design -- usability testing -- evaluation, method, evaluation methods
content.title_en: User experience design : with experience-centered software development to products that inspire

content.text: Working like never before!? : on the way to collective capacity for action. The organization of work is out of the way. We must move away from the division into alienated industrial work, unrecognized unpaid "female" reproduction work and forced unemployment. This reader is to serve as a basis for discussion and decision-making for the direction of the urgently needed conversion
content.title_en: Working like never before!? : on the way to collective action

content.text: How different are they? : the brain development of girls and boys. The American neurobiologist has already described how the brain development takes place from the moment of conception and what role genetic conditions and external influences play in this process (BA 11/01). Now she finds that gender-specific behavioral differences are often not innate, that the brains of boys and girls are almost identical before and shortly after birth rather and that only the external influences of parents, teachers and social conventions cause striking deviations during the course of development. Eliot reports numerous studies, which support her theses, shows which manifold causes gender differences between girls and boys really have and makes suggestions on how to deal with them. A very differentiated and detailed analysis, which however, also readers without scientific background will be well understandable; at the same time a dedicated, to parents and educators directed pledoyer for a departure from old role patterns and gender conventions. (2) (Reinhold Heckmann) Eliot proves that the brains of boys and girls before and shortly after the same birth and the same pattern of the brains provide for the departure of the outside parents and the brain.
content.title_en: How different are they? : the brain development of girls and boys

content.text: First help for the PC : solve every problem yourself!. New edition of the "First Aid Box", which the renowned author compiled for the first time in 2005 (BA 1/06). Outside there is a familiar picture (a rescue ring also marked the cover of the predecessor, BA 8/08), but again the author - who apparently has an inexhaustible fundus - has changed everything thoroughly compared to the edition of 2008 respectively. Of course everything was modified on Windows 7, also the already detailed "problem finder" at the beginning of the volume shows thorough changes in detail. Although you find some of the problems again (the explanations are however strongly revised), but many have also fallen away or added new. Therefore the same conclusion as last time: the old edition can remain quite true (there are still numerous XP or Vista users), but the new edition of this exemplary, practical and understandablely written guide for many PC emergencies should be added. (2) (Sch) Extensive explanations on problems that can occur when using a PC - A like battery to W.
content.title_en: First aid for the PC : solve every problem yourself!

content.title_en: Hegel Manual : Life - Work - School

content.text: Questions of use and regulation of the Internet are now posed in each and every area of society. Legal users and the right itself are therefore also required to provide answers to these questions or at least to point out a way to their answers. Therefore, based on selected individual aspects, the authors of the volume try to answer all former or current doctoral students at the University of Leipzig's Faculty of Law, civil, criminal and public law questions of use and regulation of the Internet and thereby make the legal encroachment of the supposedly "free space" internet visible. (Source: Text Verlagseinband / Verlag)
content.title_en: Legal issues concerning the use and regulation of the Internet

content.text: Transport cost management in road freight transport: basics, optimization potentials, green logistics. Verl.Beschr.: This book offers a comprehensive and application-oriented presentation of the road freight market. The focus is on the analysis of the actors, products and cost structures, supplemented by numerous current best practice case studies. For example, the possibilities and limits of a shift of truck traffic to the rail are clearly illustrated in the topic of green logistics. An ideal reference work for logistics service providers and buyers
content.title_en: Transport cost management in road freight transport : basics, optimization potentials, Green Logistics

content.text: Sports in prevention : Guide for instructors, sports teachers, physiotherapists and trainers : with 113 illustrations in 261 individual presentations and 91 tables. The book provides the practical and theoretical foundations for training, professional practice and sports practice on the topic of "preventive sports offers".
content.title_en: Sports in prevention : Manual for instructors, sports instructors, physiotherapists and trainers : with 113 figures in 261 individual presentations and 91 tables

content.text: The ground and components near the surface in the foundation area can be used for heating and cooling office buildings. The title presents systems such as energy pile, geothermal probe and foundation absorber for planners, builders and craftsmen. From the content: System overview Planning, standards and approval questions Energy and operational monitoring Experiences from realized projects Economic aspects
content.title_en: Use geothermal energy for office buildings

content.text: No panic over statistics! : Success and fun in the horror subject of nontechnical courses of study. Publisher's text: A Statistics book expressly for non-mathematicians and in unconventional ways of presentation. Statistics is feared as a mathematical discipline in many courses of study. In technical but also non-technical subjects, such as social sciences, political science, psychology, etc., statistics as an important tool represents an unpleasant hurdle for the students interested in other things. Spicy with humor and cartoons can be found for many an entertaining and carefree access to statistics and a bridge to the more serious and theoretical textbooks.
content.title_en: Don't panic about statistics! : Success and fun in the horror subject of nontechnical study programmes

content.text: Master course IT controlling : Basics and practice for IT controllers and CIOs - Balanced Scorecard - Portfolio Management - Value contribution of IT - Project controlling - Key figures - IT-sourcing - IT-cost and performance calculation. Review: Since the first edition of 2004, this work has been the first textbook to come up with a closed IT controlling concept. This benefits both teaching and corporate practice. The work is now considered the standard plant par excellence and is strongly recommended in universities and seminars as a practical basis. Further practice exercises and an exercise clause offer in particular a validation of the learning success of the students. IT controlling means service. As a contribution to the management level of the company, it supports the management of the enterprise by means of the management of the enterprise through the acquisition and job securing. Further practice tasks and an exercise clause are explained by the student's study practice statement. The fourth edition is about IT-sourcing, IT-asset management, software for IT controllers and Green IT as well as several case studies and practical examples. The statements on project controlling have been significantly extended.
content.title_en: Master course IT controlling : Basics and practice for IT controllers and CIOs - Balanced Scorecard - Portfolio management - Value contribution of IT - Project controlling - Key figures - IT-sourcing - IT-Cost- and Performance Accounting

content.text: Mathematics for industrial engineers and science and technology courses of study : Volume 2: Analysis in IRn, Linear algebra, Hilberträume, Fourieranalyse, Differential equations, stochastics. An integrated introduction to mathematics, which rises from concrete to general, dispenses with drawers such as 'Lineare algebra' and 'analysis' and which contains (almost) all the evidence. As readers, students of industrial engineering and other science and technology courses of study as well as students of economic mathematics and computer science are particularly eligible. Students of new degree programmes such as Bachelor in mathematics and even of the classical diploma course of mathematics will also read the book with profit. The presentation is exact, but less abstract.
content.title_en: Mathematics for Industrial Engineers and Science and Technology Studies : Volume 2: Analysis in the IRn, Linear algebra, Hilberträume, Fourieranalyse, Differential equations, Stochastics

content.text: The new antenna guide : Receive antennas for all wave ranges: external, indoor, temporary and active antennas. Continued the last "antenna guide" displayed in 6th edition of the same author (BA 4/05). Provides a current overview of different antenna designs for radio and radio reception according to the technical principles of radio technology. Also offers construction instructions and circuit diagrams. Has been streamlined and continuously updated compared to the previous one, previous editions (still under W. Siebel) should be deleted everywhere. (2)
content.title_en: The new antenna guide : Receive antennas for all shaft areas: outdoor, indoor, temporary and active antennas

content.text: The public interest in the debate on the reconstruction of monuments could be diminished after conservative politicians, speakers of conservative pressure groups and tourism managers seem to have managed to marginalize them as idle principle dispute among monument keepers. Why, could the reconstruction lobby ask, could a debate continue, after it seems to have been widely agreed that the reconstruction of abandoned building substance is simply a matter of course? - - The publication, which appears in the series Bauwelt Grundlagen against the reconstruction of monuments, opposes the mainstream in contentious intention. As a plea against the simulation of historical building substance, it wants to revive the reconstruction debate in the Federal Republic in content.
content.title_en: Monument conservation instead of decoy cult : against the reconstruction of monuments - an anthology

content.text: Elements of theoretical physics : Volume 1: Classical mechanics and special relativity theory An introduction to the teaching and bachelor's degree programme. The book provides the basics and most important concepts of theoretical mechanics and special relativity theory, as far as they are required in teaching and bachelor's degree programmes. This is not a presentation, as defined in the Master's or the previous degree programme, 'as comprehensive as possible', but a presentation of the theoretical pillars of modern physics, which was kept slim compared to other textbooks on theoretical physics.
content.title_en: Elements of theoretical physics : Volume 1: Classical mechanics and special theory of relativity An introduction to the teaching and bachelor's degree programme

content.text: Africa before the big jump. A kind of "positive strife" that wants to clear up the clichés of the "continent of crisis" and in return tries to highlight the potential of Africa - not only in economic terms -
content.title_en: Africa before the Great Jump

content.text: Video : cutting, upgrading and enjoying in the home cinema. The titles of the series "Digital Lifeguide" by Hanser-Verlag have so far provided competent and precise, but concise and unscrupulous information on the various sub-areas of a topic - and the title here makes no exception. Consideration is given to a successful selection of topics from the field "Digital Video" (technology of digital recording and playback devices, file formats and codecs, areas of application of various video applications, editing, storing and publishing processed videos), which are well geared to the needs of the target group "Consumer" in terms of their professional depth. The explanations are well understandable, the examples practical, also performance and price of the recommended soft and hardware products fit the target group. Good: To each chapter numerous internet sources are mentioned, which refer to further websites. Conclusion: Description of an interesting selection of individual topics of the area Digital Video, consistently geared to the skills and needs of the demanding home user. (1)
content.title_en: Video : cut, upgrade and enjoy in the home cinema

content.text: Organized : Dates, contacts, tasks always & everywhere in the grip. The new, inexpensive guide series on the digital everyday life "Digital lifeguide" (T. Schirmer: "Mobile life", ID 19/11; Ron Faber: "Games", ID 1/11 - Manfred Schwarz: "Home Media", BA 12/10 etc.) offers easy-to-understand, stimulating and useful information about everything that is now possible with digital devices in everyday life and leisure time. This edition is dedicated to the different possibilities of self-organization. With which program or with which means of Windows and Mac you can keep tasks, appointments, emails and other more in control. Efficiently organizes everyday life, that goes with computers and smartphones, with Outlook or OneNote as well as Google and other free tools. A concise, but clear and understandable book, which introduces competently and target group-oriented into the most important aspects of the topic more than just. Many good tips, hints and download addresses. For beginners a worthwhile and inexpensive entry into the topic. Uncompetitive, inexpensive, quick, concise, and flush (1).
content.title_en: Organized : Dates, contacts, tasks always & everywhere under control

content.text: Lexicon of Informatics. "The dictionary of computer science provides the necessary security in dealing with the world of concepts of information technology. The lexicon - which covers computer science representatively and currently - offers over 6000 short definitions under more than 5500 keywords - does not claim to present theories - is linguistically very dense and concise - supports cross-references the conceptual networking - places importance on linguistics, gives indications of the origin of words and adheres to a language concept, e.g. regarding anglizisms - avoids far-reaching the mention of products and short-lived characteristics - is not obliged to any manufacturer and no computer science "religion" - maintains sober distance and does not shy away from the critical note - stands me discreet humor against obscurities in IT. The focus of the revision to the 15th edition was on the areas of BI and Java technologies. Furthermore, the whole content was linguistically revised and adapted."
content.title_en: Lexicon of Computer Science

content.text: Computers and the Internet conquer childhood: from normal play behavior to addiction and its treatment. Two paediatricians and psychiators provide basic information on the current data base and on this slide help to meaningful and unhappiness-free use of children/young people with modern media, especially computers and the Internet. The majority of the book takes up findings and research results, which are well prepared with the help of tables and graphics: on media consumption of children/young people in leisure time; on the effects of the new media on behaviour, (school) performance and health; on the dangers of abuse, keyword: cybermobbing; on the connection of violent computer games and behavior; on pathological computer games and internet use (including addiction forms) and their effects on the psyche. At the end only consulting and therapy offers for affected persons and their relatives. With rich material attachment, literature and register
content.title_en: Computers and Internet conquer childhood: from normal play behavior to addiction and its treatment

content.text: Basic course on statistics in the social sciences : an easy to understand, application-oriented introduction to the necessary statistical knowledge. Publisher's text: The book is intended for social scientists who want to gain the basic knowledge necessary for them in a course of the scope of a semester. It conveys to its readers "statistical literacy" so that they can read output tables from statistical programs, classify statistical statements in scientific publications, statistically criticise opinion surveys and describe their own datasets with the basic statistical methods. It works with little mathematics, many graphics and original output of the statistics program SPSS
content.title_en: Basic course on statistics in the social sciences : an easy to understand, application-oriented introduction to the necessary statistical knowledge for social science

content.text: Probability and closing statistics : Practical introduction ; With tasks and solutions. This introductory textbook shows the entire path from the elementary determination of probabilities to the creation of theoretical probability distributions. It also explains in detail the process of statistical closing, starting from the sample selection to the sample evaluation to the parameter estimation and hypothesis testing. The focus is on the application and practical implementation of statistical methods. The author places particular emphasis on a clear, understandable and comprehensible description. To this end, all methods are presented in a clearly structured form, step by step and in detail. Exercise tasks and control questions on all chapters deepen the material. For all computational tasks to be solved a detailed solution is specified. The book is aimed at students and lecturers of the economics in basic studies at universities and universities as well as practitioners in companies dealing with statistical questions. Professor Dr. Günther Bourier teaches statistics and logistics at the University of Applied Sciences Regensburg.
content.title_en: Probability and closing statistics : practical introduction ; with tasks and solutions

content.text: IT Risk Management with System: From the basics to implementation - A practice-oriented guide. "The practical guide for IT Risk Management in the company is industry-neutral and adapted to the current situation of standardization, IT governance and the current frameworks (e.g. CobiT). The risks relating to information, IT systems and IT services are systematically addressed. The reader receives everything that is necessary to analyse and manage these risks methodically to be able to implement them safely in practice. An exemplary risk management process shows how IT risks are included in the management processes of the company together with other important risks. In this way, the business continuity and emergency management based on today's standards (e.g. BS 25999-x) is fully taken into account. In this edition, compliance topics from the perspective of risk management such as Basel II, SOX and Swiss mandatory law are updated.
content.title_en: IT Risk Management with System : From Basics to Realization - A Practice-Oriented Guide

content.text: Post-Oil City: the city of tomorrow. "Post-Oil City", the first volume of the series of political ecology in a new format, brings us closer to the city of tomorrow. Already, half of the earth's population lives in urban agglomerations - the future of humanity decides in the city. Like a combustion glass, the difficulties facing us in terms of climate change and the declining oil and other resources are bundled here. But cities are also potential spaces of the future; social, economic and ecological experiments are already taking place here, which consciously face these challenges.
content.title_en: Post-Oil City : the city of tomorrow

content.text: Questionnaire : a workbook. This book is a "practice book" in the truest sense of the word. It is intended to help researchers who want to use social science surveys in their empirical research. It is intended to provide help in the development of their questionnaires, in concrete and detailed terms. The book simulates questionnaire consultation, as the author has done for many years at the Center for Surveys, Methods and Analysis (ZUMA) in Mannheim, very practical and written in such a way that readers can work with it when developing a questionnaire, with many examples of how to do something wrong and how to do it right. After a short introduction to the cognitive psychology and communicative foundations of the survey, a variety of methodological aspects of a questionnaire are worked out, from types of questions, types of scales and the formulation of questionnaire questions to a good cover page, to survey aids and to the layout of questionnaires, all illustrated by examples from the survey practice.
content.title_en: Questionnaire : A workbook

content.text: 3D CAD with Inventor 2011 : Tutorial with a continuous project example. Publisher's text: This tutorial describes the creation of a complete project vice in a very vivid and step by step way. This allows us to understand the course of action at any time. In addition to pure 3D modeling, the design of presentations and animations is also presented and thus a holistic approach is realized. content.text: The rising public debt in Germany and Europe is highly worrying. As high debt is accompanied by a high proportion of interest expenditure on total expenditure, the scope for spending on other policy areas is reduced. If the government is not counterbalanced in time, states are threatened with insolvent. As the debt is largely not cyclically conditioned, the necessary consolidation of public finances must begin to reduce structural deficits. In this study, the Kronberg district presents its own proposals for consolidating public finances and for further development of the legal framework in Germany and Europe. These include the hardening of the Stability and Growth Pact, the introduction of an insolvency regime for EU member countries, the further development of the debt brake for the federal and state governments as well as fundamental reforms of the German tax and social system. Because only successful consolidation creates the framework conditions for sustainable economic growth.
content.title_en: Renovating public finances permanently - in Germany and Europe

content.text: Empty status of residential buildings in rural areas: examples of selected municipalities in the Länder of Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate and Saarland. Ageing and population decline will lead to significant problems on housing markets in sparsely populated rural regions that are not situated in the surrounding areas of large cities. There will be impairments up to the unsaleability of real estate and empty buildings in these villages and small towns. The following questions will be the focus of the working group from the LAG Hessen/Rheinland-Pfalz/Saarland: To what extent will there be vacancy? What effects does this have on the appearance of the villages? What possibilities exist for the municipalities, the land and real estate institutions to provide planning, political and financial assistance in this area? The aim of the AG is to present a pilot study, ways and means of dealing with the vacancy of residential properties in rural areas. To this end, methods of recording and forecasting vacant spaces will be demonstrated using three case examples. On this basis, informal, financial and legal instruments will be examined, which can be suitable for the value development and utilization of residential properties in rural areas.
content.title_en: Empty status of residential buildings in rural areas : Examples of selected municipalities in the Länder of Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate and Saarland

content.text: Human Factors: Psychology of safe action in risk industries. In areas such as aviation, nuclear power, chemical industry, medicine and military, people work with complex technical systems. But in critical situations, man, not the machine, and often under time pressure and with high risk, can have dramatic consequences. Risk industries therefore need measures that minimize sources of error, promote safe action and adequately consider the "human factor". Such measures offer this standard work of Human Factors psychology, updated and revised for the second edition: In the first part of the book, scientists explain concepts for safety, errors and human action. In the second part, experienced practitioners and scientists present current challenges of individual industries and present solutions: How are processes and systems safer and communication made more effective? How can complexity be reduced? What role do personnel management or new forms of cooperation play? How can teamwork be trained? Safety officers, managers, personnel and psychologists in risk industries, engineers, trainers and students find in this book current concepts of human factor psychology clearly explained and illustrated with exciting case studies.
content.title_en: Human Factors : Psychology of Safe Acting in Risk Industries

content.text: Incognito : the secret life of our brain. Eagleman is an internationally known American neuroscientist, the book was a "New York Times" bestseller and the title has just been set to jump to the "mirror" bestseller list. The consciousness, Eagleman writes, is not at the center of our brain. And more than that: We can consciously control hardly anything of what is happening in our brain. He explains his theses with a multitude of scientific experiments and impressive examples from everyday life; he also draws on the results of his own research. In the last chapter he discusses how responsible we are for our actions, and considers whether we have a soul that is independent of the biology of our body. He also has revealing examples and explanations on these questions. A remarkable book, really continuing and the look at ourselves changing as well as exceptionally written, vividly and captivating; to read with great profit even for the lay people not familiar with matter. content.text: Investment in hunger? : Land Grabbing and food security in Sub-Saharan Africa. The rapidly increasing trend of Land Grabbing in developing countries has taken on considerable proportions since the financial and food price crises in 2007/2008. While some people have repeatedly pointed out the advantages of land investments, there are significant risks for the target companies - probably the biggest is the threat to their food security. Based on international studies, documents and media reports, Daniela Kress presents the current state of research, the complexity and versatility of the phenomenon Land Grabbing. She presents insights about the connection between the shops with land and food security using the example of the sub-Saharan Africa region and discusses possible future developments. Daniela Kress is a graduate regional scientist (LA) and was working at the Chair of International Politics and Foreign Policy of the University of Cologne. She works as a freelance editor for the ZfAS (Zeitschrift für Außen- und Sicherheitspolitik). (Source: www.buchhandel.de 11.09.2012)
content.title_en: Investment in hunger? : Land Grabbing and food security in Sub-Saharan Africa

content.text: Ach, Afrika: Berichten aus dem Inneren eines Kontinent. Updated paperback edition of the great and exciting reports Bartolomäus Grills (see BA 1/04). The author, who has been a correspondent of large German-language newspapers in Africa for 20 years, even living in South Africa, sees the continent as a very positive revolution; Africa has become more peaceful, democratic and prosperous in the last decade (introduction). Thus, since the first edition in 2003, there has been much to repeat, supplement and update; a new final chapter has been added. Based on his profound knowledge, "Grill writes critical-analyzing, subjective, apologetic; he can make it clear that complex historical-political processes are understandable and sometimes funny" (review of the first edition, see above). - Also currently one of the best books on Africa, which should be widely offered. The preliminary edition should be made. (2) (LK/F: Dankert) Exciting repprtages of the Africa correspondent of the "Time" (including) about the changing continent, its black/K.
content.title_en: Ach, Africa : Reports from the interior of a continent

content.text: A lifelong teacher? : Alternatives to the teacher's profession. The need for German schools is great: a third of the teachers suffer from burnout syndrome, another third is chronically overloaded, and 10 percent of the teachers' referendums break their vocational training prematurely. This book takes the suffering pressure of the affected seriously and helps potential dropouts to find the right way
content.title_en: Lifelong teachers? : Alternatives to the teaching profession

content.text: The houses of the others: Roman. Christopher and Luisa have married and set up in life: He is a prospective professor of biology, she is a successful art historian. They have exchanged the old building apartment of their student days for a house on the outskirts of the city as a visible sign of their ambitions. Here in the street on the Kuhlmühlgraben their marriage must prove itself, here they measure their dreams on achieved. But not everything can be done with willpower and self-presentation, that must be experienced by the two as well as the other inhabitants of the district. Silke Scheuermann tells in "The houses of the others" of fragile desires, fears and hopes and describes what happens when people align their lives with others and their supposed superiority is shaken or if they are surprised by happiness. "Some narrative threads hang in the air, and sometimes the tissue is rather thready; the - based on self-experienced - story of the two homosexuals, whose sole purpose for life is wickedness and psychoterror, for example hardly comes over clichés.
content.title_en: The houses of the others : Roman

content.text: Matter: Basic texts on the history of theory. Matter is a key category in the history of philosophy. Since antiquity, the relationship between mind and matter has been disputed, and with the emergence of modern natural sciences the complexity of the debate is increasing: Matter is now increasingly dynamized, even "dematerialized". The volume presents central texts from the discussion of this subject from Anaxagoras and Aristotle to Albert Einstein, Willard Van Orman Quine and Judith Butler. It introduces comprehensively into the history of philosophical and natural science discussions with the concept and phenomenon of matter and illustrates how the former could also become a central category of cultural studies, for example in the field of text sciences, gender studies or material and objects culture.
content.title_en: Matter : Basic texts on the history of theory

content.text: The history of the Amistad : Slave trade and human smuggling on the Atlantic in the 19th century. The Cologne Latin American historian and Cuban expert (most recently ID-B 24/12) Michael Zeuske, who was already involved in slavery in Cuba in "Black Caribbean" (ID-G 40/04), focuses here on the Atlantic slave trade and human smuggling in the 19th century, which had been continued in the course of decades after the official abolition (see A. Hochschild: "Sprengt die Schetten", BA 12/07). Unlike the title suggests, the slave uprising on the schooner "Amistad" is not primarily the focus of this detailed, with numerous sources documented. Zeuske rather takes the rebellion as an occasion to depict the history of the Atlantic slavery system and the illegal mechanisms of human trafficking within the framework of global economic contexts. In addition to the Hispanic-Cuban slave trade, he deals in detail with the African slave trade centres. With maps and literature. After Jochen Meisner: "Black Africa" (BA 8/8/8).
content.title_en: The history of Amistad : slave trade and human smuggling in the Atlantic in the 19th century

content.text: Corporate Museums : concepts, ideas, realization : concepts, ideas, implementation. With articles by Jan-Christian Warnecke, Mateo Kries and Uwe R. Brückner. Museums among others by Adidas exhibition (Herzogenrauch), BMW museum (Munich), Braunsammlung (Kronberg im Taunus), Surgical Museum Asklepios (Tuttlingen), Fein Markenwelt (Schwaebisch Gmünd - Bargau), Juraworld of coffee (Niederbuchsiten), Mercedes-Benz Museum (Stuttgart), Uzin Utz exhibition (Ulm)
content.title_en: Corporate Museums : concepts, ideas, realization : concepts, ideas, implementation

content.text: What are the challenges facing planning rights and procedures in the face of increasingly articulated demands for participation? And how can and should the expert knowledge of citizens complement the knowledge of experts? Civil society engagement is synonymous with the will to shape the living environment and thus increasingly becomes a fixed size for politics and planning. Volume 6 of the IBA series of writings asks about the opportunities and consequences of this development for the future of cities. Practical examples provide insights into the planning and participation methods of several German cities and regions around the world. A particular focus is on the experiences of IBA Hamburg with very different participation formats, which are commented on from several perspectives. Ultimately, the focus is on the level of attention that planners and politicians meet with citizens and on how planning processes should adapt to the constantly changing social conditions in a forward-looking and innovative way.
content.title_en: Metropolis: civil society

content.text: Filigree lightness: discover extraordinary grass gardens. This beautiful book of pictures deals with seductive grass compositions. While for a long time the garden gardeners were "disposable", they are now an important element in modern garden design. The book takes the viewer on a journey through impressive and fascinating grass gardens in France, Great Britain, Belgium and the Netherlands. The large-format pictures of the presented gardens speak for themselves. Therefore, the text is limited to scarce information. Often the plantings seem like carefully woven carpets. Since grass gardens are very easy to care for, they are even more attractive for garden owners. Although in some gardens completely without colorful flowers, they do not seem boring, since planting with grasses always brings naturalness into the garden. Other original design ideas with grasses and plant portraits of important ornamental grasses are found in the closing chapters.
content.title_en: Filigree lightness : discover extraordinary grass gardens

content.text: The methodology of geography teaching is a book for students, referendars and experienced teachers who want to teach geography with success and joy. Written by a school practitioner, the main focus here is on current findings from various fields of education in the field of education, which have proved to be suitable for everyday teaching in the field of school teaching for geography. The experiences with students from uncounted successful and also less successful teaching situations were more important for this book than the theoretical discourse on an academic meta level. In a timely guide, the reader is given examples of applications for varied geography teaching in and outside the school room in numerous excursions. Suggestions for thinking about teaching and an open view of his own profession play a special role here: "Only teachers who convince themselves professionally and humanly achieve their address types and can convey learning successes and impressions that enrich them."
content.title_en: Geography Teaching Methodology
Lead, zinc, tin and their alloys

content.text: Since the issue of environmental protection has moved into social awareness of the problem of even system-faithful groups of the population, it is said that a new "green capitalism" is being discussed, which is not only to heal the wounds of nature, but also to give new impetus to the prevailing economic system. Climate change, poisoning of the seas and drinking water resources, increasing species extinction
content.title_en: What every environmentalist needs to know about capitalism

content.text: Audio technology : for event technicians in training and practice ; with 74 tables and 152 exercises ; [incl. video technology]. Clearly structured illustrated textbook on professional audio and event technology. For trainees and users. The clear systematic structure is loosely oriented towards the framework curriculum for training as "specialist for event technology" and begins with the physical foundations of sound, then passes to the topic audio electronics (audio transmission, recording, digitisation) and then treats equipment and equipment of audio technology
content.title_en: Sound technology : for event technicians in training and practice ; with 74 tables and 152 exercises ; [incl. video technology]

content.text: Nation-Building in Afghanistan: Legitimate deficits within political reconstruction. In December 2001 an ambitious goal was set on the German Petersberg: Afghanistan should be pacified, rebuilt and democratized. But between the fall of the Taliban at the end of 2001 and the announced change of strategy of American President Obama in December 2009, there are about eight unsuccessful years of war and reconstruction on the Hindu Kush. Martina Meienberg analyses why political reconstruction in Afghanistan has failed in many areas. The investigation of the case-example shows how the interventions have affected the behaviour of various actors, including the Karzai government, the Taliban and the members of the Bundeswehr.
content.title_en: Nation-Building in Afghanistan : Legitimate deficits within political reconstruction

content.text: Detect and treat writing disorders in children : the practical book for therapy and pedagogy; [with explanations on RAVEK-S]. This book describes motor writing disorders in children and adolescents and their causes and shows how children can be supported in a targeted way.
content.title_en: Detect and treat writing disorders in children : the practical book for therapy and pedagogy; [with explanations on RAVEK-S]

content.text: IT outsourcing in practice: strategies, project management, cost effectiveness. The reduction of IT costs while increasing competitiveness is more than ever the focus of strategic considerations in the economy. IT outsourcing is one of the top topics in the management days of companies. Torsten founders and other experts describe in this eBook practical and understandable the established service models in the outsourcing market. The focus is on: - success-critical aspects of outsourcing project management - transparent design of the performance relationship - governance and controlling - pricing models and leasing - transition of personnel and economic assets - legal aspects The eBook is characterized by high practical relevance. The author is a proven outsourcing expert.
content.title_en: IT outsourcing in practice : strategies, project management, cost-effectiveness

content.text: More participation ventures : arguments for increased participation of children and young people; [with recommendations for action for municipalities]. Main description: Our society faces reform tasks in all policy areas. To master these requires more civic commitment than ever. A new culture of participation is needed, and the young generation plays an important role in this. Children and young people are almost always affected by political decisions - but rarely have an opportunity to influence them. Changing this situation requires above all a rethinking of actors in politics, administration and schools - municipalities can only develop themselves in the long term with the participation of all generations.
content.title_en: More participation ventures : arguments for increased participation of children and young people; [with recommendations for action for municipalities]

content.text: Calculus versus catastrophe: Communication of climate change. Especially the science of climate change claims and gets the public, but also in an ambivalence-influenced relationship with the mass media. Friedemann Lembcke shows that it is less a problem to solve in the communication of climate change, than a reciprocal condition of calculus and catastrophe communication. Friedemann Lembcke received his doctorate from Prof. Dr. Norbert Bolz at the Institute for Language and Communication at the Technical University of Berlin and is a research associate in the field of climate effects and vulnerability at the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research. Especially the science of climate change claims the public and gets it, however, in a relationship with the mass media that is characterized by ambivalence. Friedemann Lembcke shows that it is less a problem to solve in the communication of climate change, rather a reciprocal condition of calculus and catastrophe communication.
content.title_en: Calculation versus Disaster : Communication of Climate Change

content.text: The IT-Management is a critical factor for the sustainable business and/or organization success, whether it is about the content of the IT-Management and/or the content of the IT-Management. The IT-Management is a key task of the top management level. It is a critical factor for the sustainable business and/or organization success, whether it is about supporting internal processes or offering IT-based services and products. HMD 284 provides a current outline of the relevant approaches and experiences and addresses questions of the ROI-Ermittlung and IT-Governance as well as that of the architecture and service management main description of the IT-Management and/or the content of the IT-Management and/or the content of the IT-Management and/or the content of the IT-Management.
content.title_en: Strategic IT management : IT project governance, corporate architecture management, Agile IT application landscapes, IT outsourcing, IT management, collaboration roadmapping, corporate information management, sustainable IT management

content.text: Army in action : 20 years of foreign operations of the Bundeswehr ; a publication of the Rosa Luxemburg Foundation. Reader's annotation : Political science contribution to the change of German foreign and military policy since 1990. Among other things, the changes in the political and legal framework for the worldwide military use of the Bundeswehr are described
content.title_en: Army in action : 20 years of foreign service of the Bundeswehr ; a publication of the Rosa Luxemburg Foundation

content.text: Differential geometry : Curves - Surfaces - Multifolds. This book is an introduction to differential geometry and a fitting companion to the differential geometry module (one and two-emestrig). First, it deals with the classical aspects such as the geometry of curves and surfaces, before looking at higher-dimensional surfaces as well as abstract manifolds. The interface is the central chapter "The inner geometry of surfaces". This leads the reader to the famous sentence of Gauss-Bonnet, which represents a crucial link between local and global geometry. The second half of the book is dedicated to Riemann's geometry. The conclusion is a chapter on "Einstein-Raums", which has a great significance both in "Clean Mathematics" and in the general relativity theory of A. Einstein. It places great value on visuality, which is supported by numerous illustrations.
content.title_en: Differential geometry : curves - surfaces - manifolds

content.text: Chemical process engineering : Calculation, design and operation of chemical reactors. Practical and theoretically sound textbook on modelling, design and operation of chemical reactors. Readers are enabled to systematically penetrate the processes in chemical reactors and to record them in the mathematical model.
content.title_en: Chemical process engineering : Calculation, design and operation of chemical reactors

content.text: Profession - Politics - Transparency : Additional activities rules for members of the Bundestag in international comparison. The scandal surrounding the secondary activities of members of the Bundestag in 2005 showed how critically the public observed the financing of the political class. The scandal led to the introduction of transparency rules, which were not only discussed before the Federal Constitutional Court. Stephan Malessa examines the system conformity of the secondary activities rules from a political scientific perspective. In doing so, he first analyses the political implications of the published secondary activities. In addition, he examines the connection between the professionalization of parliaments and the sharpness of the respective transparency rules by means of an international comparison.
content.title_en: Occupation - Politics - Transparency : Additional activities rules for members of the Bundestag in an international comparison

content.text: Embedded Programming : Basic knowledge and application examples of the Infineon XC800 family. Main description: This book presents embedded programming of microcomputers based on specific examples of the Infineon XC800 family. The focus is on programming examples in the language C, which make the solution of concrete tasks easy for the reader to understand; assembler programs and other basics are the subject of the book as it is necessary for understanding. Sample solutions and the sample programs used are available for download. The execution of the programs can be done on real hardware as well as in simulator operation of the free development environment.
content.title_en: Embedded Programming: Basic knowledge and examples of the Infineon XC800 family

content.text: Construction services ; 11: Room and timber construction works VOB/STLB construction : Standards ; VOB Part B: DIN 1961; VOB Part C: ATV DIN 18299, ATV DIN 18334. Contains: DIN 1052-10:2012 ; DIN 1961:2012 ; DIN 4074-1:2012 ; DIN 4074-5:2008 ; DIN 18065:2011 ; DIN 18203-3:2008 ; DIN 18299:2012 ; DIN 18334:2012 ; DIN 68365:2008 ; DIN 68368:2006 ; DIN 68705-2:2003 ; DIN 68740-2:1999 ; DIN 68762:1982 ; DIN 68800-1:2011 ; DIN 68800-2:2012 ; DIN 68800-3:2012 ; DIN EN 300:2006 ; DIN EN 312:2010 ; DIN EN 315:2000 ; DIN EN 336:2003 ; DIN EN 622-1:2003 ; DIN EN 622-2:2004 ; DIN EN 622-2:2006 [Reporting 1] ; DIN EN 622-3:2004 ; DIN EN 636:2012 EN EN 1306:2005 : EN 139-8:2005 ; DIN EN 139-3:2005 ;
content.title_en: Construction services ; 11: Room and wood construction works VOB/STLB construction : standards ; VOB part B: DIN 1961; VOB part C: ATV DIN 18299, ATV DIN 18334

content.text: Ford Fiesta from 10/08 : [with current-flow diagrams]. The guide from the proven series offers detailed maintenance and maintenance instructions for the compact car models manufactured from October 2008 and can also be carried out by ambitious DIY enthusiasts. With well illustrated work steps, fault tables and current-flow diagrams. No comparable title to the models presented here is known so far. (2) (LK/EF: Empty) Rich illustrated guide that offers detailed maintenance and repair instructions for the models built from 2008 on. (LK/EF: Empty)
content.title_en: Ford Fiesta from 10/08 : [with circuit diagrams]

content.text: Experimental Physics 1 : Mechanics and Warmness. MECHANIK and WÄRME are the first of four volumes on experimental physics by Professor Demtröder. The teaching contents of the first semester physics are vivid and easy to understand, but presented as quantitatively as possible. Important definitions and formulas, all illustrations and tables were designed in two colours. Calculated examples in the text, chapter summaries and exercises with detailed solutions at the end of the book help to cope with the material and stimulate our own collaboration. Color plates on selected topics contribute to the fun of this book. The sixth edition has been reworked and updated.
content.title_en: Experimental Physics 1 : Mechanics and Heat

content.text: Greenpeace sustainability barometer: What moves the youth?. The Greenpeace sustainability barometer was developed and carried out on behalf of Greenpeace by the Institute for Environmental Communication at Leuphana University of Lüneburg. The study examines how the status quo of education for sustainable development and environmental education is in Germany. Michelsen ("The Fischer-Öko-Almanach", here last BA 7/91) notes with his team: The youth thinks environmentally conscious and perceives climate change as a serious problem. This is the result of the nationwide representative survey, which selected 1,070 15- to 24-year-olds randomly and interviewed in July 2011. The figures thus confirm the 16th Shell youth study "Youth 2010" (BA 12/10). With 27 figures, 36 tables and detailed literature list. (3) (Heidi Best-Sendel) Results of the nationwide representative survey of 15- to 24-year-olds and qualitative interviews from 2011 on the topic "Sustainability". (Heidi Best-Sendel)
content.title_en: Greenpeace sustainability barometer : What moves youth?

content.text: Metropolis Ruhr : Landsundliche Besuchung des neuen Ruhrgebiet. Current developments in the Ruhr metropolis in five sections: Starting points
content.title_en: Metropolis Ruhr : a national account of the new Ruhr area

content.text: Data quality in databases. If one develops application systems, one is repeatedly confronted with the integration, integration or exchange of data. Everyone who knows this knows how hard it is to first recognize data problems and then to fix them. Especially in the development of data warehouse systems, where different data stocks are to be integrated into a common data stock, the recognition of problems without corresponding software-tools is often a true "Sisyphos" work. If one depends here only on conventional SQL instructions, the knowledge about problems remains just superficial. A claim of data quality in databases is therefore to show approaches, how one can extend relational database management systems with data quality procedures.
content.title_en: Data quality in databases

content.text: The end of the coincidence: how big data predicts our lives. "Big data", "data mining" and "predictability", i.e. the collection of large amounts of data and the resulting prognosis of our actions, whether as consumers, investors, private people or possibly criminals, are the focus of the latest "data revolution" (see also "Data Unser", ID-A 15/12). "Recorded Future" is called e.g. a company from this industry, of which the radio and television man (Ö3, SAT.1, premiere) and communication consultant reports in his flott written book. Network formation, linking, social media - the networked society develops into a predictable society; in the run ahead, those who developed or could afford the best "crystal balls" and finally: "Beautiful new data world - end with chance"! That sounds good and boring at the same time. The core question remains: Who collects data for what purpose? Here, to demand more transparency and democratic participation, as the author does, sounds good, but it must be good.
content.title_en: The End of Chance: How Big Data Makes Our Life Predictable

content.text: HTML5 and CSS3: the new web standards in practical use; develop innovative web pages and apps - including JavaScript APIs and Responsive Design; 16 hours of professional practice knowledge. The trainer of this video training is a proven expert of web technologies. He has a description of the future new HTML standard ("HTML5", BA 9/10). The learning video shown here is based on a training with the exact same title (ID-B 13/12), which however had to be achieved in contrast to the current 16-hour version with 9 hours running time. Both the technical equipment and the intuitive operation are again high quality and need no criticism. In terms of content the chapters were strongly tuned. Partially the chapters were extended (graphic programming), partly completely new topics were taken up (form technology, APIs for mobile web apps). The trainer formulates clearly, understands and is quite flat on the road, but also requires preliminary knowledge. For absolute beginners the "Little Boxes (ID-A 6/12) is still well suited. This new Galileo course should be offered in parallel to the predecessor. Demand guaranteed. (1) (L/H comprehensive) The possibilities of HTML5 and the future is explained in terms of the HTML/H.
content.title_en: HTML5 and CSS3 : the new web standards in practical use ; developing innovative websites and apps - including JavaScript APIs and Responsive Design ; 16 hours of practical knowledge from the professional

content.text: The book on transport: the fascinating world of mobility and logistics. The engineer offers a broad overview of freight transport, passenger transport, communications, the current state of transport technology and the future prospects. He strives to achieve a balanced presentation using tables and numerous illustrations, but can only inspire many topics such as environmentally friendly transport policy (cf. Winfried Wolf: "Verkehr, Umwelt, Klima", BA 2/08). The style is understandable, but occasionally cumbersome and academically marked. On the other hand, the approximately 160-page-wide core of the book, namely the history of traffic, which is illustrated with maps and images attractively from the stone age to the present (sober C. Merki: "Verkehrsgeschichte und Mobilität", ID 48/08), is well-performed. This chapter can already address pupils. A material-rich volume with strengths and weaknesses, which is worth its money and can be recommended for large stocks in view of the extensive equipment. A concentrated textbook wrote by Uwe Köhler with "Introduction to Traffic Planning" (ID-G 23/14). (3) (Rolf Raschka) The overview of the transport time of the traffic technology is illustrated the traffic technology, the present day, the traffic history.
content.title_en: The Book of Transport: the Fascinating World of Mobility and Logistics

content.text: Coordination Chemistry. Since Alfred Werner formulated his coordination theory a little over a hundred years ago, complex chemistry of transition metals has rapidly developed into one of the most important research areas of inorganic chemistry.The multifaceted nature of coordination chemistry is already indicated by the variability of the compounds, which include small molecules such as hexacarbonyl chromium as well as metal enzymes.This textbook is aimed at students in the main study. All important aspects of coordination chemistry - for example ligand field theory, binding theory, properties ...
content.title_en: Coordination Chemistry

content.text: UrbanRESET: Uncovering the potential of urban spaces; how to activate immanent potentials of urban spaces. Angelus Eisinger (*1964). Studied economics. 2003 Habilitation at ETH Zurich. Private lecturer at ETH Zurich (2003-2009), Professorship for Urban Planning and Spatial Development at the University of Liechtenstein (2005-2008), since March 2008 Professor of History and Culture of the Metropolis at HCU Hamburg. Free expert position as consultant and juror with the office Perimeter City in Zurich. Member of the advisory board of IBA Basel 2020, the artistic advisory board of the Swiss Architecture Museum (S AM) and the monument council of the city of Hamburg. Nina Brodowski (*1979). Studied Applied Cultural Sciences in Lüneburg. Subsequently, she worked as a research associate in the Scandinavian evaluation and consulting company Rambøll Management in the field of family-friendly urban development. Since October 2008, she has been a research associate at Angelus Eisinger at HCU Hamburg. Jörg Seifert (*1971).
content.title_en: urbanRESET : Unlocking immanent potentials of urban spaces ; how to activate immanent potentials of urban spaces

metadata.authors: Eisinger, Angelus; Seifert, Jörg; Brodowski, Nina

content.text: Lasers: Basics and applications in photonics, technology, medicine and art. The first laser was built as a laboratory device in early 1960. However, it has only been in the past twenty years that lasers have been produced more reliably, more stable, more compact and cheaper. Since then, the triumphal march of lasers has been unstoppable. Many "technical achievements", especially in production technology, are based on the use of lasers. Laser technology is today a special field of expertise. With the development of durable, stable and cheaper semiconductor lasers in combination with modern optics, as well as more powerful electronics and the use of lasers, lasers are now a special field of expertise.
content.title_en: Lasers : Basics and Applications in Photonics, Technology, Medicine and Art

content.text: The fight for electricity: myths, power and monopolies. Since Angela Merkel's "energy turnaround" is said to have turned the turbo on and the nuclear power plants off, the chaos is still very clear in terms of energy supply. The Renewable Energy Act (EEG) is to be abolished, but then it is not, offshore wind farms are started with a lot of wind, then stopped. Power grids are planned, but not built. Suddenly nobody knows where it actually goes. Instead, lobbyists of all origins dominate the discussion, the politicians turn to one, then to the other wind direction, and the people yearns back to old times, when the electricity just came out of the socket - and in the end the people are supposed to pay for the whole mess even the coal. Claudia Kemfert explains to us all - citizens, politicians and the economy - the energy turn. Now is the time to act. content.text: From the Big Bang to the modern man: the development of the world in ten steps. From the Big Bang to the formation of galaxies, suns and planets, to the emergence of life and evolution, which is culminating in man. In addition to the Big Bang, elementary particles, galaxies, dark matter, multiverses and the possible end of the universe are also discussed in Chapter 1. The formation of stars and planets and the prerequisites for the formation of life. The fundamental meaning of carbon and water is dedicated to Chapter 4. It follows the treatment of the biochemical foundations of life, the necessity of multicellularity, the Darwinian theory of evolution, the development of mammals and finally of man. In the last chapter, the view is speculated about the future of humanity, whereby the world strives for an "evolutionary convergence point", after which it goes downhill, represents a basis.
content.title_en: From Big Bang to Modern Man: the Development of the World in Ten Steps

content.text: The theory that did not want to die: as the English pastor Thomas Bayes discovered a rule that, after 150 years of controversy, is no longer to be thought away from science, technology and society. Bayes's sentence allows work with conditional probabilities that are omnipresent in practice and research. It is therefore applied in insurance, econometrics, decision theory and quality management, among other things, to medical forecasts and model traffic flows. Since it allows to conclude from an effect on the probability of an underlying cause, it is of central importance in all questions of learning from experience (testing hypotheses, estimating parameters). This is the history of a mathematical knowledge and its emergence, development and application in the context of long-term controversy as to its validity and applicability.
content.title_en: The theory that did not want to die: as the English pastor Thomas Bayes discovered a rule that after 150 years of controversy is now indispensable from science, technology and society

content.text: The city in space: ideas, designs and designs in pre-modern Europe. A frequently asked demand to historicalize the city in its multi-dimensional relationship to the surrounding and co-generated spaces is addressed and redeemed in the contributions of the present volume by medieval, early modern historians and art historians. Three main topics are the development of urban space, the expansion of urban space into the surrounding area and the participation of urban actors in the construction of supra-local spaces. The approaches of recent urban history research, state education research and diplomacy history as well as environmental and art history are brought together and mutually fruitfully made.
content.title_en: The city in space: ideas, designs and designs in pre-modern Europe

content.text: From heroes and victims: cultural history of the German war memorial. Cultural history of the German war memorial in the 19th and 20th centuries, which documents the change from the Siegerdenden Monument to the Memorial. Review: Cultural history of the German war memorial from the Napoleonic wars to the present day, focussing on the war 1870/71, the 1st and the 2nd World War. The author describes the change of war memorial from the Siegerdenden Monument to the Memorial on the basis of the dramatic historical upheavals of this period. And he shows that this also means that the reception of the historical monument is subject to change. The presentation also always goes into detail, i.e. over 30 concrete monuments (with a certain emphasis on the Southwest of Germany) are described and classified; also on the musical and above all literary commemoration is addressed. Black and white illustrations, literature catalogue, registers. This thorough work on war memorials complements the thematically further literature such as U. Schlies overview of German national monuments (2002) and P. Reichels presentation of all German state symbols (2012).
content.title_en: Of heroes and victims : Cultural history of the German war memorial

content.text: The number that came from the cold: when mathematics becomes an adventure. The Austrian mathematics professor Taschner can be called the feuilletonist of mathematics. As one could already find in his earlier volumes "Der Zahlen ganzige Schatten" (ID-B 30/05) and "Das Infinite" (ID-B 50/05), he needs space and time to develop his thoughts. He also likes to mention historical backgrounds, describes the thought processes of important mathematicians and opens doors to mathematical thought buildings, be it Hilbert's hotel, Gödel's theorem or philosophical considerations about the infinite. As it is a good feuilleton, he does not overburden his readers with mathematical formulas; where this is necessary, it will be banished to an appendix. On the other hand, he does not shy away from explaining in the chapter the Knuthian arrow notation for potency towers in the chapter on large numbers. He is also responsible for the transfer of this bridge to the close institutional connection of university art history in Cologne with the practice of building research and preservation of monuments. - - With this volume, colleagues, friends and students congratulate Norbert Nußbaum on his 60th birthday. The topics and methods of the contributions are intended to trace the interests and career of the jubilee: from building research to comprehensive representations of structural problems of construction art to theoretical reflection of academic teaching and work.

content.text: Thinking about urban development: Building blocks for an interpretation in the 21st century. Urban development today faces a multitude of social and ecological challenges in the face of a variety of influences such as globalisation, climate change and demographic change, the scarcity of fossil resources and the energy transition. These can only be overcome by means of concepts that integrate urban planning, social science and design aspects equally. In this book twelve experts explore the contribution that the relatively young discipline Urban Design can make to this.
content.title_en: Thinking about urban planning: Building blocks for an interpretation in the 21st century

content.text: Thailand's diverse landscapes: geology and relief, climate, vegetation and use. This colourful volume presents Thailand's diverse landscapes and explains their origins against the background of earth history, climate and not least the ever-increasing human influences that they created, and at some points threatens them. The author complements the description with data on climate, water balance, use and vegetation of the landscapes; from tropical rainforests in the south to monsunt-rock forests to tropical cloud forests in Thailand's mountains. The book is richly illustrated with over 200 colored pictures and maps as well as many tables, a bibliography completes the work. The German-Thai society wants to address all visitors and friends of Thailand with this volume, who are interested in the development and geographical background data of these exceptionally varied landscapes of Thailand, besides culture and inhabitants.
content.title_en: Thailand's diverse landscapes : geology and relief, climate, vegetation and use

content.text: Religionhybride: Religion in post-traditional contexts. The University of Rostock investigates how these communities represent expressions of religious productivity. Are new forms of religion or religiously overformed lifestyles emerging from religious practices beyond institutionalized religious practices? Contrary to the revision-needed thesis of the disappearance of religion, it is intended to be brought into view how religion in old village churches and other auratic places may re-emerge and be different. Thus, the special forms of communitization and networking, fixed cultures and events such as court festivals, valuations and social motives are also under consideration. content.text: Social Media. Platforms such as Facebook, Wikipedia, YouTube or Twitter have changed the Internet considerably in recent years. They are considered to be "social media", because they have a great influence on how people present themselves and their interests on the Internet, how they maintain relationships, re-establish themselves and inform themselves about relevant topics. At the same time they raise a number of far-reaching questions: Does social media leave privacy? Does social media make everyone a journalist? Do social media bring knowledge for everyone? Are social media participative - or monitor and control people? The volume answers these questions from a sociological perspective and thus gives an overview of how social media transforms our individual everyday life as well as our society. The content - self-presentation and privacy - The end of journalism? - Participation in knowledge worlds - The participation paradox The target groups - Decision-makers in the field of politics and media - Journalists - Teachers - Students of the upper level/Abiturients - Beginners The author Dr. Jan-Hinrik Schmidt is a scientific speaker for digital interak-tive media and political communication at the Hans-Bow-Institute of Hamburg

content.text: Universities as regional innovation drivers? : Innovation transfer from universities and its importance for regional development. The study is based on an empirical analysis of the innovation process in four East German case studies regions Dresden, Halle, Jena and Rostock. All four regions have both a university and an industrial tradition. However, the development processes since the system broke down in 1990 are different in these regions. The study is based on various data sources: In addition to the analysis of university statistics, the statistics of employees subject to social security contributions and patent statistics, two extensive postal surveys were carried out. One of these surveys was directed at regional key actors (industrial and chamber of commerce, patent offices, trade unions, etc.) and aimed at assessing regional circumstances. Addressees of the second survey were professors in the universities studied. Here, the scope, type, procedure and problems of cooperation activities were discussed. The findings obtained here were further deepened by a series of interviews with actively cooperating professors and the management of universities.
content.title_en: Higher education as a regional innovation driver? : Transfer of innovation from higher education institutions and its importance for regional development

content.text: Management of destinations. Main description: Destinations are the actual competition units in tourism. Because destinations consist of people as citizens and not only employees, because destinations consist of different independent companies and not only of subordinate departments, because tourism generates various external effects and for various other reasons new approaches are needed for the management of destinations. How does a coherent tourist product arise in a destination, what conditions of success can be derived for strategies of destinations, how can the success of a destination be measured in the competition, how can strategies be asserted internally despite contradictory interests of citizens and companies? For these and other explanations and design questions the present book provides answers. First in the German-speaking area it deals with the topic of destination management, which is important in connection with the revitalization of tourism.
content.title_en: Management of destinations

content.text: The focus: Marine worlds: Journey into the unknown depths of the oceans. The focus: Marine worlds "To go where no human has been yet" - this is not only the motto of the science fiction series Star Trek, but also of most marine scientists. Because large parts of this vast habitat are still almost unexplored. Only gradually the veil of the mystery begins to open. Thus biologists not only succeeded in the first census in the oceans, geoscientists have also discovered with the help of modern diving robots as bizarre as exciting phenomena in the deep sea. Strange asphalt volcanoes belong to it just as much as brooding geysers and even corals in night-dark blackness. The book presents the exotic wonder worlds of our oceans in detail. It also explains how they originated and why some of them are in danger.
content.title_en: Focus: Ocean worlds : Journey to the unknown depths of the oceans
